overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Recovering from Averages: An Inverse Problem Perspective on Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 从平均值中恢复：机器学习原子间势的反问题视角
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26819v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate the potential energy surface of atomistic systems from quantum-mechanical reference data and enable molecular simulation at near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Since they are fitted to total energies and forces, it is not obvious what is estimated: the total energy or the many-body potentials from which it is assembled. Mathematically, this can be formulated as a question whether a function can be recovered from averages of its values over random clusters. We study it for a linear model of fixed correlation order in simplified statistical setting. We show that, in the population limit, the potential is identifiable in a natural weighted Sobolev space, and derive finite-sample recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments for pair, three-body, and four-body models support the theory.
full_list.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 根据量子力学参考数据近似计算原子系统的势能表面，并以接近从头算的精度实现分子模拟，且成本仅为一小部分。由于它们是根据总能量和力拟合的，因此估计的内容并不明显：总能量或多体势。从数学上讲，这可以表述为一个问题：函数是否可以从随机簇上的平均值中恢复。我们研究了简化统计设置中固定相关阶数的线性模型。我们证明，在人口限制下，潜力在自然加权索博列夫空间中是可识别的，并得出有限样本恢复保证。成对、三体和四体模型的数值实验支持了该理论。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《从平均值中恢复：机器学习原子间势的反问题视角》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: E2Former-V3: Atom-Role-Aware Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: E2Former-V3：原子角色感知等变原子间势
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials approach density-functional accuracy, but explicit-solvent atom counts are dominated by hydrogens and water. Uniform equivariant architectures still give every atom the same latent width and number of expensive block updates. To our knowledge, no prior method reallocates capacity by chemical role while retaining every atom and its first-principles force. We introduce E2Former-V3, which treats capacity as an atom-level resource: a static chemical role, assigned before the backbone runs, sets each atom's latent width and update count. No atom is removed, no coordinate is integrated out, and every force remains the gradient of one conservative energy. Standard reduces only the update count, sending hydrogen through half as many full-width block updates; on OMol25 validation it reaches a force mean absolute error (MAE) of 8.146 meV/Angstrom, against E2Former-V2's published 8.38, at 1.75-1.84x V2's throughput with lower peak memory on one H200. Flash also narrows the low-resolution stream to one eighth of the high-resolution width (32 vs 256 channels) and routes water oxygen with hydrogen, reaching 4.00-4.88x on three solvated systems (up to 5.85x in the pure-water all-low-resolution limit) at 11.272 meV/Angstrom, trading force accuracy for speed. Across 54 20 ps MD legs, a 100 ps NVE check, and a 1 ns NVT run on a 32,437-atom solvated protein, all runs complete; the MD legs show no non-finite values, clashes, or water fusion, and water O-O and Na-O RDF peak positions match experiment within 0.04 Angstrom. E2Former-V3 therefore moves the accuracy-throughput frontier for all-atom, conservative simulation, not a uniform accuracy win: Standard is worse on biomolecules and metals, better on electrolytes and organics; energy MAE is higher than E2Former-V2's; and water densities remain about 7.5% too high. Code: https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM.
full_list.abstract_zh: 机器学习的原子间势接近密度泛函精度，但显式溶剂原子计数以氢和水为主。统一的等变架构仍然为每个原子提供相同的潜在宽度和昂贵的块更新数量。据我们所知，现有方法还没有通过化学作用重新分配容量，同时保留每个原子及其第一原理力。我们引入了 E2Former-V3，它将容量视为原子级资源：在主干运行之前分配的静态化学角色，设置每个原子的潜在宽度和更新计数。没有原子被移除，没有坐标被积分，并且每个力仍然是一个保守能量的梯度。标准仅减少更新计数，通过一半的全角块更新发送氢；

full_list.title_en: Prediction of lattice thermal conductivity of half-Heusler compounds by machine learning and transfer-function calibration
full_list.title_zh: 通过机器学习和传递函数校准预测半赫斯勒化合物的晶格热导率
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput searches for half-Heusler thermoelectrics increasingly rely on lattice thermal conductivity (κ_L) from first-principles calculations, or from machine-learning models trained on them. These calculations describe an ideal single crystal, whereas measurements are made on polycrystalline samples, in which grain boundaries and defects scatter heat as well. The resulting gap between calculated and measured κ_L has been noted for individual compounds but not, to our knowledge, quantified across a materials class, so the values used for screening carry an unknown, systematic bias. Here we quantify and correct this bias for cubic half-Heusler compounds with 18 valence electrons. Using a curated literature corpus that keeps calculated and measured values apart, we show that calculations overestimate measured κ_L in most bonding families, and that the excess shrinks with temperature. Scattering by defects, added to the intrinsic scattering between lattice vibrations, would give such a trend, but the data do not single out one cause. A simple transfer function with this temperature dependence removes the median offset, and refitting its magnitude within a bonding family lowers the median error further, though not consistently compound by compound. Combined with a machine-learning model that predicts the calculated value from crystal structure, and tested on chemistries withheld from all fitting, the method predicts measured κ_L in this class about as closely as independent laboratories agree with one another, and provides testable predictions for compounds not yet measured.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。使用将计算值和测量值分开的精选文献语料库，我们表明计算高估了大多数键合族中的测量 κ_L，并且超出部分随着温度而缩小。缺陷的散射加上晶格振动之间的固有散射，会给出这样的趋势，但数据并没有指出一个原因。具有这种温度依赖性的简单传递函数消除了中值偏移，并且在键合族中重新拟合其大小进一步降低了中值误差，尽管化合物之间的复合并不一致。该方法与根据晶体结构预测计算值的机器学习模型相结合，并对所有拟合中保留的化学物质进行测试，预测此类中测量的 κ_L 与独立实验室之间的一致程度接近，并为尚未测量的化合物提供可测试的预测。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过机器学习和传递函数校准预测半赫斯勒化合物的晶格热导率》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Machine-learning molecular dynamics reveals dynamic interfacial structure and active-site accessibility in Fe–N–C single-atom catalysts
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine-learning molecular dynamics reveals dynamic interfacial structure and active-site accessibility in Fe–N–C single-atom catalysts
full_list.abstract: Fe–N–C single-atom catalysts are promising Pt-free catalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction. However, molecular-level understanding of their aqueous interfaces remains limited because ab initio molecular dynamics is restricted to small systems and picosecond timescales, whereas existing classical force fields lack the accuracy and transferability required to describe Fe–water coordination and interfacial solvent structure. In this study, we developed an ensemble of equivariant neural-network potentials for the Fe–N–C/water system using spin-polarized density functional theory reference data. Using these potentials, we performed molecular dynamics simulations of up to 5 ns for an interface containing 320 water molecules. Our simulations reveal persistent axial coordination of water at the Fe sites and a locally stabilized hydrogen-bond network. Enhanced sampling shows that coordinated water can exchange between opposite sides of the Fe–N 4 plane through a low-energy pathway with a barrier of ∼0.07 eV, whereas blocking backside solvent access in a bilayer model strongly suppresses this exchange and prolongs site hydration. Constrained ab initio simulations further show that O 2 can approach the Fe site from the side opposite to the coordinated water, while no physically reasonable direct-displacement pathway is identified from the water-coordinated side within the present sampling protocol. Additionally, electronic-response calculations averaged over multiple configurations reveal a contact region with low polarizability, which limits the electronic capacitance of the contact layer under ion-free conditions resembling the potential of zero charge. These results clarify how dynamic hydration governs interfacial structure and active-site accessibility at Fe–N–C/water interfaces.

full_list.title_en: Solving fermionic sign problems with physics-informed kernels
full_list.title_zh: 使用物理内核解决费米子符号问题
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend the generative sampling approach with physics-informed kernels (PIKs) [1,2] to a general class of physics systems with complex distributions and a structure also encountered in fermionic systems. The resolution of sign problems of generic weighted sums of complex Gaußian distributions with the PIK approach is central to this application. In a first step, PIKs map a real normal distribution to such a weighted sum, and this procedure is called the PIKfan. The PIKfan has the sampling cost of a real normal distribution. In a second step, this weighted sum is evolved with a second PIK into the distribution of the theory at hand. In combination, we reduce the sampling task for a general class of complex systems to a Gaußian one, and the main computational task is that of computing the PIK. We illustrate the approach with the one-site Hubbard model at arbitrary chemical potential and with φ⁴-deformed extensions of it.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们将具有物理信息内核（PIK）[1,2]的生成采样方法扩展到具有复杂分布和费米子系统中也遇到的结构的一般类物理系统。使用 PIK 方法解决复杂高斯分布的通用加权和的符号问题是该应用的核心。第一步，PIK 将真实正态分布映射到这样的加权和，这个过程称为 PIKfan。 PIKfan 具有真实正态分布的采样成本。第二步，使用第二个 PIK 将这个加权和演变成当前理论的分布。结合起来，我们将一类复杂系统的采样任务简化为高斯系统，主要的计算任务是计算 PIK。

full_list.title_en: Axial Thermal Transport in Transition Metal Chalcogenide Nanowires from Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Simulations
full_list.title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学模拟中过渡金属硫族化物纳米线的轴向热传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition metal chalcogenide M6X6 nanowires (M = Mo or W; X = S, Se, or Te) are promising one-dimensional (1D) building blocks for nanowire bundles and arrays, but how elemental composition controls their intrinsic axial heat transport remains unclear. Here we develop a multicomponent neuroevolution potential (NEP) from first-principles reference data and use homogeneous nonequilibrium molecular dynamics (HNEMD) simulations to quantify the thermal conductivity of six MX6 nanowires. The Mo6X6 series show a nonmonotonic composition dependence, whereas the thermal conductivity of the W6X6 series decreases monotonically with increasing chalcogen mass. Frequency-resolved thermal conductivity and phonon mean-free path analyses show that axial heat conduction is dominated by low-frequency phonons. Vibrational density of states and spectral energy density analyses further reveal that the contrasting trends arise from a competition between metal-chalcogen vibrational matching and phonon softening induced by heavier chalcogen atoms. A phenomenological model incorporating the combined atomic mass and the relative mass difference between the metal and chalcogen atoms reproduces these trends. These results link elemental composition, phonon characteristics and axial thermal conductivity in M6X6 nanowires, providing an atomistic basis for selecting heat-conducting units in nanowire bundles and arrays.

full_list.title_en: Beyond the Ground State: Assessing the Machine-Learned Skala Functional in ΔSCF Calculations of Molecular Excitation Energies
full_list.title_zh: 超越基态：评估分子激发能 ΔSCF 计算中的机器学习 Skala 泛函
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We assess the transferability of the machine-learned Skala exchange-correlation (XC) functional beyond ground-state energetics using molecular vertical excitation energies and singlet-triplet gaps calculated with the Δ-self-consistent-field (ΔSCF) approach. We compare Skala with PBE, r²SCAN, and PBE0 on subsets covering small-molecule excitations (QUEST1), inverted singlet-triplet gaps (ST-gap), and intramolecular charge-transfer excitations (QUEST6). Both spin-unrestricted Kohn-Sham (UKS) and restricted open-shell Kohn-Sham (ROKS) formalisms are considered. On QUEST1, Skala achieves the lowest mean absolute errors (MAEs) for singlet and triplet excitation energies with both formalisms, although PBE0 and r²SCAN provide more accurate singlet-triplet gaps through error cancellation. For ST-gap, Skala yields the lowest gap MAEs with both UKS and ROKS. Evaluating the mixed-spin and triplet energy components on the same orbitals optimized for the ROKS open-shell singlet yields negative splittings for seven of eight ST-gap molecules with Skala. Separate triplet optimization increases the gaps, but six remain negative. All three conventional functionals give positive common-orbital splittings and optimized gaps for all eight molecules. For QUEST6, treated with UKS only, Skala yields more accurate singlet excitation energies than PBE and r²SCAN but remains less accurate than PBE0. Across QUEST1 and ST-gap, Skala yields lower MAEs with UKS than ROKS. Overall, these results support Skala's transferability to molecular excited states while highlighting its dependence on the excitation class and open-shell treatment.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用分子垂直激发能和通过 Δ 自洽场 (ΔSCF) 方法计算的单重态-三重态能隙来评估机器学习的 Skala 交换相关 (XC) 函数在基态能量学之外的可传递性。我们将 Skala 与 PBE、r²SCAN 和 PBE0 在涵盖小分子激发 (QUEST1)、反向单重态-三重态间隙 (ST-gap) 和分子内电荷转移激发 (QUEST6) 的子集上进行比较。自旋无限制 Kohn-Sham (UKS) 和受限开壳 Kohn-Sham (ROKS) 形式主义均被考虑。

full_list.title_en: ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery. Yet an MD study requires an expert-driven workflow: designing the simulation, writing reliable input scripts, executing them, and analyzing the results with separate tools. Here we present ChatAtom, a multi-agent large language model system that translates a natural-language request into a complete MD workflow without the user writing input scripts or analysis code. Each agent has a defined responsibility within the workflow. An orchestrator plans the study; the LAMMPS and OVITO agents each use a generator-reviewer pair to prepare and review simulation and visualization scripts before execution; a high-performance computing agent dispatches jobs to remote resources; and an analysis agent interprets the completed run. The work- flow is accessible through a browser interface that streams thermodynamic data and rendered frames during local execution, allowing users to follow the simu- lation as it progresses. The architecture also supports new capabilities through loadable skills without modifying the agents, enabling autonomous hypothesis generation and testing. We evaluate ChatAtom through script-generation bench- marks, an end-to-end study of crack propagation, and a closed-loop campaign. By bringing script generation, execution, visualization, and analysis into one reviewed and observable pipeline, ChatAtom lowers the barrier to conducting MD studies and broadens access to advanced simulation workflows.

full_list.title_en: Generating grain boundary structures at a specified energy with a symmetry-constrained diffusion model
full_list.title_zh: 使用对称约束扩散模型在指定能量下生成晶界结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) govern many properties of polycrystalline materials, and inverse design would make the GB structure itself a design variable. Crystal generative models such as MatterGen operate on periodic cells, which contain two GBs. The cell energy defines a single GB only when the two are equivalent, but existing models do not enforce this equivalence. Building on MatterGen, we developed a symmetry-constrained diffusion model in which the two GBs are related by a symmetry operation: atoms near one GB are generated, and those near the other are reconstructed through a symmetry projection applied at every denoising step. We applied it to the Σ 5(210)[001] symmetric tilt GB in Al, conditioning generation on the GB energy from a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). All 350 generated structures kept a geometrically equivalent GB pair after relaxation. Given a target GB energy, the model generated structures at that energy: for the three in-range targets with many nearby training structures, 44% to 70% fell within ± 0.1 J/m² of the target. Tracking weakened at higher energies and failed outside the training range. Of the 91 near-target structures, 90 matched no training structure under the adopted geometric criterion, indicating that the model can propose configurations near the target energy that are distinct from the training structures, a capability that could help identify unknown metastable GB structures observed in experiments. Building GB-pair equivalence into generation thus makes GB properties well-defined design targets, enabling inverse design of GB structures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。我们将其应用于 Al 中的 Σ 5(210)[001] 对称倾斜 GB，通过机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 调节 GB 能量的生成。所有 350 个生成的结构在松弛后都保持几何等效的 GB 对。给定目标 GB 能量，模型会生成该能量的结构：对于具有许多附近训练结构的三个范围内目标，44% 到 70% 落在目标的 ± 0.1 J/m² 范围内。跟踪在较高能量下减弱，并且在训练范围之外失败。在 91 个接近目标的结构中，有 90 个在采用的几何标准下与训练结构不匹配，这表明该模型可以提出与训练结构不同的目标能量附近的配置，这种能力可以帮助识别在实验中观察到的未知亚稳态 GB 结构。将 GB 对等价性构建到生成中，从而使 GB 属性成为明确定义的设计目标，从而实现 GB 结构的逆向设计。

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Sampling non-abelian lattice gauge theories with diffusion models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present gauge-equivariant diffusion models as samplers for lattice gauge theories (LGTs). Using lattice gauge-equivariant convolutional neural networks (L-CNNs) and the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm (MAALA), we are able to accurately sample two-dimensional U(2) field configurations and show first promising results for four-dimensional SU(3). Our two-dimensional models extrapolate remarkably well to larger inverse couplings than originally trained on. We confirm this by comparing observables to analytically known values and to hybrid Monte Carlo results.

full_list.title_en: Probabilistic physics-informed neural solvers for Woods–Saxon parameter identification: a coupled forward–inverse approach
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Probabilistic physics-informed neural solvers for Woods–Saxon parameter identification: a coupled forward–inverse approach
full_list.abstract: We introduce a probabilistic physics-informed learning framework that couples quantum-state reconstruction with dataset-level identification of globally shared Hamiltonian parameters from bound-state spectra. The Woods–Saxon inverse problem provides a physically interpretable test case involving multiple nuclei, neutron and proton sectors, and Coulomb and spin–orbit contributions. WaveNet represents separated radial, polar, and azimuthal wavefunction components, while ParamNet combines normalized radial probes, observed energies, nuclear descriptors, and quantum numbers to infer a distribution over six global parameters. Training jointly enforces Rayleigh-energy consistency, separated Schrödinger residuals, boundary and phase conditions, explicit normalization, selective orthogonality, spin–orbit splitting consistency, and Kullback–Leibler regularization. The physics-informed formulation supports learning from limited spectral observations without supervised wavefunction labels, using only experimental energies from four nuclei. Spectral evaluation uses the physical-space distribution mean. The learned standard deviations describe model-dependent parameter variability. In synthetic closure tests, all six generating parameters are recovered with sub-percent relative errors. Reintroducing the inferred means into an independent finite-difference (FD) solver gives spectral mean absolute errors of for the Seminole parameterization and for Wahlborn. For experimental spectra, the inferred Seminole interaction gives an aggregate mean absolute error of , compared with for the reference interaction and for a FD least-squares fit using the same identification levels. Identification within the Wahlborn expression reduces the corresponding error from to . The framework provides a reusable and robust scientific-machine-learning formulation for inverse quantum eigenvalue problems in which globally shared parameters and physically constrained states must be identified jointly.
full_list.summary: We introduce a probabilistic physics-informed learning framework that couples quantum-state reconstruction with dataset-level identification of globally shared Hamiltonian parameters from bound-state…
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Probabilistic physics-informed neural solvers for Woods–Saxon parameter identification: a coupled forward–inverse approach》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
full_list.title_zh: 用于碱活化渣性能预测和设计空间探索的反应性机器学习
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.06765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. The average metal oxide dissociation energy (AMODE), a physically interpretable representation of precursor reactivity, provides a compact alternative descriptor to explicit oxide compositions while enabling comparable predictive performance. Model interpretation revealed physically consistent trends from heterogeneous data, including non-monotonic effects of Na2O dosage and silicate modulus, reduced predicted strength at higher water content and larger specimen size, and coupled oxide-level effects more coherently represented by AMODE than by individual oxide contents. Statistically constrained design space exploration reveals reactivity-dependent trade-offs among strength, embodied CO2 emissions, and cost. The design maps identify high-strength regions with substantially lower CO2 emissions than OPC-based references at similar cost. Overall, this work demonstrates how reactivity-informed ML can extract physically meaningful trends from heterogeneous AAS data and guide source-dependent binder design. The curated dataset is publicly accessible to support advances in cement and concrete research.
full_list.abstract_zh: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。在逐渐丰富的特征场景中对多种机器学习 (ML) 算法进行了基准测试，证明整合 GGBS 成分、细度、固化条件和样本几何形状可以提高预测性能。平均金属氧化物解离能 (AMODE) 是前体反应性的物理可解释表示，为明确的氧化物成分提供了紧凑的替代描述符，同时实现了可比较的预测性能。模型解释揭示了异质数据的物理一致趋势，包括 Na2O 用量和硅酸盐模量的非单调效应、较高含水量和较大样本尺寸时预测强度的降低，以及 AMODE 比单个氧化物含量更连贯地表示耦合氧化物水平效应。统计约束的设计空间探索揭示了强度、二氧化碳排放量和成本之间依赖于反应性的权衡。设计图确定了高强度区域，其二氧化碳排放量比基于 OPC 的参考在相似成本下要低得多。总体而言，这项工作演示了基于反应性的 ML 如何从异构 AAS 数据中提取物理上有意义的趋势，并指导依赖于源的 Binder 设计。整理的数据集可公开访问，以支持水泥和混凝土研究的进步。
full_list.summary: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《用于碱活化渣性能预测和设计空间探索的反应性机器学习》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Spectral functions of an extended antiferromagnetic S=frac12 Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice
full_list.title_zh: 三角晶格上扩展反铁磁 S=frac12 海森堡模型的谱函数
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Markus Drescher, Laurens Vanderstraeten, Roderich Moessner, and Frank Pollmann Quantum spin liquids are exotic phases of matter that do not form magnetic order, even at zero temperature. Instead, a single spin flip breaks apart into two independent emergent fractionalized particles, leaving a distinctive continuum in neutron-scattering spectra. Here, using GPU-accelerated dynamical matrix-product-state simulations, the authors compute such spectra for a frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnet with new levels of accuracy. The results support the existence of two spin-liquid phases, a U (1) Dirac spin liquid and a chiral spin liquid. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 295119] Published Mon Nov 23, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者：Markus Drescher、Laurens Vanderstraeten、Roderich Moessner 和 Frank Pollmann 量子自旋液体是奇特的物质相，即使在零温度下也不会形成磁序。相反，单个自旋翻转分裂成两个独立的出现的碎裂粒子，在中子散射光谱中留下独特的连续谱。在这里，作者使用 GPU 加速的动态矩阵乘积状态模拟，以新的精度水平计算受抑三角晶格反铁磁体的此类光谱。结果支持两种自旋液相的存在，即 U (1) 狄拉克自旋液体和手性自旋液体。

full_list.title_en: Energy spectra and cascade in the spin turbulence of a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Energy spectra and cascade in the spin turbulence of a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.00766v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the spin-interaction energy spectrum of spin turbulence in a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate. Continuous spin driving of a spin-1 condensate produces a nonequilibrium steady state with spatially fluctuating magnetization. We observe a power-law scaling consistent with the -7/3 exponent predicted for spin-wave turbulence, which persists across our full range of drive strengths despite substantial changes in the spectral anisotropy. After switching off the drive, we track the free-decay evolution and find evidence consistent with a direct cascade of spin-interaction energy toward higher wavenumbers. These results establish an energy-spectral hallmark of spin turbulence and enable quantitative studies of cascade dynamics in spinor superfluids.

full_list.title_en: A conservative latent neural ODE for stiff collisional-radiative plasma kinetics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A conservative latent neural ODE for stiff collisional-radiative plasma kinetics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collisional-radiative (CR) models govern the non equilibrium population kinetics of partially ionized plasmas and are a dominant cost in integrated edge and divertor plasma simulations, where a stiff system of dozens to thousands of coupled rate equations must be solved at every spatial cell and time step. We present a two-stage machine learning (ML) surrogate that replaces the direct CR solve with a compact, continuous-time, deployable dynamical model. Stage~1 is a grey-box autoencoder that compresses a high-dimensional ion population vector into a low-dimensional latent space in which four coordinates, one per charge state of the lithium system studied here, are emphfixed to the physical charge-state distribution and the rest are learned. Stage~2 is a latent neural ODE that learns the continuous-time evolution of the latent variables. We (i) integrate in a density-folded, logarithmic clock on which the latent trajectory is smooth enough for an explicit integrator, (ii) sample time adaptively by latent arc length so the sharp ionization transition is resolved, (iii) add a linear damping toward an estimate of the CR steady state as a design choice, and (iv) enforce mass conservation directly. The surrogate is accurate, with a charge-state error that is unchanged under refinement of its output grid, over full-trajectory rollouts within the trained horizon, and exactly conservative: on 1480 held-out trajectories at the trained conditions it reproduces the charge-state evolution with a median absolute error of 4.2×10⁻³ on fractions in [0,1], conserves mass to 10⁻⁷, {and evaluates a full sixteen-decade trajectory in sim76,μs per trajectory in batched inference on a single GPU.} A model retrained with whole (nA,Te) grid points withheld is equally accurate at those unseen conditions.

full_list.title_en: Measuring and predicting plasma blob influence on downstream transport through paired simulations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Measuring and predicting plasma blob influence on downstream transport through paired simulations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use two-dimensional TOKAM2D simulations of flux-driven turbulence to measure how much a single plasma blob affects particle transport farther out in the scrape-off layer. We evolve the same turbulent state twice, weakening the density and potential variations of one blob in one of the two simulations. The resulting difference in outward particle flux, integrated over time in each poloidal sector of a downstream band, defines the blob's influence vector α. Its magnitude falls steeply with distance from the band and generally increases with blob size and density content. Even blobs with similar bulk properties can differ in influence by orders of magnitude. A graph neural network that uses the recent evolution of the fields in and around each blob predicts much of this difference for pairs of otherwise similar blobs. To see how the difference develops, we compare the downstream density and radial velocity in the two simulations. For both strongly and weakly influential blobs in the pairs examined, changes in radial velocity account for most of the local change in outward flux. In the stronger responses, the density and flow contributions tend to reinforce each other in the same sectors at the same times.

full_list.title_en: BioEmu2: Scalable Emulation of Biomolecular Dynamics
full_list.title_zh: BioEmu2：生物分子动力学的可扩展模拟
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite major advances in structure prediction, modelling the motions and interactions that drive biomolecular function at scale remains a central challenge. We introduce BioEmu2, a generative model for atomically resolved biomolecular structures combining static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling and time evolution, that samples orders of magnitude faster than molecular dynamics (MD). Trained on experimental and synthetic structures and extensive MD data, it supports multi-component systems containing proteins, nucleic acids, modified residues, ligands and ions. Structure-prediction accuracy is comparable to top open-weight biomolecular folding models, and a context parallel mode enables prediction of megadalton complexes. Equilibrium distributions approximate MD references with free-energy errors near 1 kcal/mol across tested proteins and complexes. Time propagation predicts long-timescale dynamical trajectories and kinetics of binding and conformational changes. Generated structures can be controlled by conditioning on residue contacts or steering with user-defined bias potentials. Enhanced sampling enables free energy calculation involving rare states. BioEmu2 makes the study of biomolecular ensembles and dynamics scalable.
full_list.abstract_zh: 尽管结构预测方面取得了重大进展，但对大规模驱动生物分子功能的运动和相互作用进行建模仍然是一个核心挑战。我们引入了 BioEmu2，这是一种原子分辨生物分子结构的生成模型，结合了静态结构预测、平衡采样和时间演化，其采样速度比分子动力学 (MD) 快几个数量级。它经过实验和合成结构以及广泛的 MD 数据的培训，支持包含蛋白质、核酸、修饰残基、配体和离子的多组分系统。结构预测精度可与顶级开放重量生物分子折叠模型相媲美，并且上下文并行模式可以预测兆道尔顿复合物。

full_list.title_en: Designing Perovskites for Chemical Looping Hydrogen Production
full_list.title_zh: 设计用于化学循环制氢的钙钛矿
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perovskites are promising materials for chemical looping hydrogen production (CLHP) due to their compositional flexibility and tunable redox properties. However, cation substitution opens a vast compositional space, making screening for new high-performing materials computationally demanding. Here, an autonomous active-learning framework combining a Wasserstein autoencoder (WAE) with a deep ensemble surrogate model was used to search for perovskites with a high hydrogen production capacity (HPC). In seven independent runs of 50 cycles, the mean HPC of the acquired compositions rose from 0.41 mmol H₂ g⁻¹ in the starting set to 2.05 mmol H₂ g⁻¹, and the best compositions reached 2.65-2.99 mmol H₂ g⁻¹. All runs enriched Sn on the B-site, mostly combined with Ti and with Mg, Ce, K and Y on the A-site. Twenty diverse candidates (2.22-2.84 mmol H₂ g⁻¹) were then selected by a multi-objective ranking that also accounts for raw-material price, supply resilience and potential environmental and health impacts. The approach links materials discovery with practical deployment constraints, and the methodology is transferable to other chemical looping processes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿由于其成分灵活性和可调节的氧化还原特性，是用于化学循环制氢（CLHP）的有前途的材料。然而，阳离子取代开辟了广阔的组成空间，使得筛选新型高性能材料的计算要求很高。在这里，将 Wasserstein 自动编码器 (WAE) 与深度集成代理模型相结合的自主主动学习框架用于搜索具有高产氢能力 (HPC) 的钙钛矿。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 钙钛矿由于其成分灵活性和可调节的氧化还原特性，是用于化学循环制氢（CLHP）的有前途的材料。然而，阳离子取代开辟了广阔的组成空间，使得筛选新型高性能材料的计算要求很高。在这里，将 Wasserstein 自动编码器 (WAE) 与深度集成代理模型相结合的自主主动学习框架用于搜索具有高产氢能力 (HPC) 的钙钛矿。在 7 个独立运行的 50 个循环中，所获得的组合物的平均 HPC 从起始组中的 0.41 mmol H2 g-1 上升到 2.05 mmol H2 g-1，并且最佳组合物达到 2.65-2.99 mmol H2 g-1。所有的 B 位均富含 Sn，大部分与 Ti 结合，并且在 A 位上与 Mg、Ce、K 和 Y 结合。然后通过多目标排名选出 20 种不同的候选药物（2.22-2.84 mmol H2 g⁻1），该排名还考虑了原材料价格、供应弹性以及潜在的环境和健康影响。该方法将材料发现与实际部署限制联系起来，并且该方法可转移到其他化学循环过程。

full_list.title_en: Molecular structure breaks universality in screening behavior of electrolyte solutions
full_list.title_zh: 分子结构打破了电解质溶液筛选行为的普遍性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrostatic screening is one of the most fundamental phenomena in electrolyte solutions. While dilute electrolytes are described by the universal Debye--Hückel theory, recent experiments have reported an apparently universal scaling law for screening lengths in concentrated electrolytes, fueling ongoing debate over anomalous underscreening. Yet, liquid state theory has been unable to determine whether molecular details of the solvent, the ions, or both should preserve or break such universality. Using machine-learned classical density functional theory, we compute numerically exact decay lengths across a hierarchy of electrolyte models of increasing molecular complexity. We find that molecular details qualitatively reshape screening: solvent attraction generates a new monotonic decay mode, solvent polarity produces re-entrant behavior, and ionic structure alone can drastically alter screening-length exponents. Consequently, no single scaling law describes screening universally across these molecularly distinct electrolytes. Our results challenge equilibrium interpretations of experimentally observed universality in concentrated electrolytes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 静电屏蔽是电解质溶液中最基本的现象之一。虽然稀电解质是由通用的德拜-休克尔理论描述的，但最近的实验报告了一种明显通用的用于浓电解质筛选长度的比例定律，引发了关于异常筛选不足的持续争论。然而，液态理论一直无法确定溶剂、离子或两者的分子细节是否应该保持或破坏这种普遍性。使用机器学习的经典密度泛函理论，我们在分子复杂性不断增加的电解质模型层次结构中以数值方式精确计算衰减长度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 静电屏蔽是电解质溶液中最基本的现象之一。虽然稀电解质是由通用的德拜-休克尔理论描述的，但最近的实验报告了一种明显通用的用于浓电解质筛选长度的比例定律，引发了关于异常筛选不足的持续争论。然而，液态理论一直无法确定溶剂、离子或两者的分子细节是否应该保持或破坏这种普遍性。使用机器学习的经典密度泛函理论，我们在分子复杂性不断增加的电解质模型层次结构中以数值方式精确计算衰减长度。我们发现分子细节定性地重塑了筛选：溶剂吸引力产生新的单调衰减模式，溶剂极性产生重入行为，而离子结构本身就可以极大地改变筛选长度指数。因此，没有单一的比例定律描述了对这些分子不同的电解质的普遍筛选。我们的结果挑战了实验观察到的浓电解质普遍性的平衡解释。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Stall-Triggered Newton-Krylov-Assisted DIIS and Its Machine-Learning-Accelerated Variant for CCSD Convergence
full_list.title_zh: 失速触发牛顿克雷洛夫辅助 DIIS 及其用于 CCSD 收敛的机器学习加速变体
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The iterative solution of the non-linear amplitude equations of coupled-cluster singles doubles (CCSD) theory can encounter convergence instabilities, asymptotic convergence or outright divergence. Direct Inversion in the Iterative Subspace (DIIS) is a widely used extrapolation technique but can also exhibit slow or oscillatory convergence in challenging regimes. In this work, we introduce a robust hybrid solver: Stall-Triggered Newton-Krylov Assisted DIIS ({}stNK-DIIS) alongside its machine-learning accelerated variant {}stNKML-DIIS which leverages the robust convergence of Newton-Krylov (NK) while avoiding the high computational cost of Krylov iterations. In our methods, DIIS remains the default accelerator and a matrix-free NK procedure is activated when sustained stagnation or divergence is detected with each NK step verified using the non-linear residual before acceptance. To alleviate the cost of Krylov iterations the {}stNKML-DIIS uses a gated recurrent unit (GRU) to predict a scalar logarithmic step-size ratio along the approximately computed Newton direction. When the ML-predicted step fails residual-based verification, the method falls back to a grid-based NK line search. Using CCSD as the underlying electronic-structure theory, we evaluate these methods against conventional DIIS and pure NK for stretched molecules exhibiting convergence difficulties in terms of residual convergence, iteration counts, and wall-time performance. These protocols may be generalizable to other non-linear equation solvers as well, as the ML model learns the convergence pattern of the variables and does not require system-specific knowledge such as atom identities or molecular orbital properties. This allows transferability across atom-type, bonding character and basis-sets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 耦合簇单双打 (CCSD) 理论的非线性振幅方程的迭代解可能会遇到收敛不稳定、渐近收敛或彻底发散的情况。迭代子空间中的直接反演 (DIIS) 是一种广泛使用的外推技术，但在具有挑战性的情况下也可能表现出缓慢或振荡收敛。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 耦合簇单双打 (CCSD) 理论的非线性振幅方程的迭代解可能会遇到收敛不稳定、渐近收敛或彻底发散的情况。迭代子空间中的直接反演 (DIIS) 是一种广泛使用的外推技术，但在具有挑战性的情况下也可能表现出缓慢或振荡收敛。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种强大的混合求解器：失速触发 Newton-Krylov 辅助 DIIS ({}stNK-DIIS) 及其机器学习加速变体 {}stNKML-DIIS，它利用 Newton-Krylov (NK) 的稳健收敛性，同时避免 Krylov 迭代的高计算成本。在我们的方法中，DIIS 仍然是默认加速器，并且当检测到持续停滞或发散时，将激活无矩阵 NK 程序，并且在接受之前使用非线性残差验证每个 NK 步骤。为了减轻 Krylov 迭代的成本，{}stNKML-DIIS 使用门控循环单元 (GRU) 来预测沿近似计算的牛顿方向的标量对数步长比。当 ML 预测步骤未能通过基于残差的验证时，该方法会回退到基于网格的 NK 线搜索。使用 CCSD 作为基础电子结构理论，我们针对在残余收敛、迭代计数和墙时间性能方面表现出收敛困难的拉伸分子，针对传统 DIIS 和纯 NK 评估了这些方法。这些协议也可以推广到其他非线性方程求解器，因为机器学习模型可以学习变量的收敛模式，并且不需要特定于系统的知识，例如原子身份或分子轨道属性。这允许跨原子类型、键合特征和基组的可转移性。
full_list.summary: 耦合簇单双打 (CCSD) 理论的非线性振幅方程的迭代解可能会遇到收敛不稳定、渐近收敛或彻底发散的情况。迭代子空间中的直接反演 (DIIS) 是一种广泛使用的外推技术，但在具有挑战性的情况下也可能表现出缓慢或振荡收敛。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《失速触发牛顿克雷洛夫辅助 DIIS 及其用于 CCSD 收敛的机器学习加速变体》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Role of antisite disorder in dictating the Ising anisotropy and ferromagnetic ground state of NdGaSi
full_list.title_zh: 反位无序在决定 NdGaSi 伊辛各向异性和铁磁基态中的作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions together set the magnetic ground state of rare-earth intermetallics, yet the role of chemical disorder on the ligand sublattice remains little explored. Here, we show that Ga/Si antisite disorder in NdGaSi stabilises the centrosymmetric I4₁/amd structure and raises the Nd³⁺ site symmetry to D₂d, which forbids all m=±2 Stevens operators in the crystalline electric field (CEF) Hamiltonian. Magnetization, specific heat, single-crystal neutron diffraction, and x-ray absorption spectroscopy establish the disordered structure and a collinear ferromagnetic order below T_Capprox11~K with Ising anisotropy along c. A CEF analysis that fits the susceptibilities along both axes and the magnetic specific heat simultaneously yields a ground-state doublet that is sim97% pure, in contrast to the strongly mixed ground state of the Al/Si-ordered NdAlSi (C₂ᵥ site symmetry of Nd³⁺). We argue that this ground-state purity makes the ordered moment rigid against the modulation due to frustrated exchange, selecting a k=0 ferromagnet in NdGaSi instead of the incommensurate ferrimagnet of NdAlSi. Antisite disorder, thus, acts as a handle on CEF ground-state purity and can, thereby, select between fundamentally different magnetic ground states.
full_list.abstract_zh: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。 CEF 分析同时拟合沿两个轴的磁化率和磁比热，产生纯度为 sim97% 的基态双峰，这与 Al/Si 有序 NdAlSi 的强混合基态（Nd3⁺ 的 C2ᵥ 位点对称）形成鲜明对比。我们认为，由于交换受阻，这种基态纯度使得有序矩对调制变得刚性，选择 k=0 的 NdGaSi 铁磁体而不是 NdAlSi 的不相称亚铁磁体。因此，反位点无序充当 CEF 基态纯度的手柄，从而可以在根本不同的磁性基态之间进行选择。

full_list.title_en: Decoupling Exciton Energetics from Wavefunction Geometry in Imide-Based Defect Double Antiperovskites
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Decoupling Exciton Energetics from Wavefunction Geometry in Imide-Based Defect Double Antiperovskites
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The excited-state properties of imide-based defect double antiperovskites AE₅AsPn(NH)₂ (AE = Ca, Sr; Pn = Sb, Bi) are investigated using spin--orbit-coupled quasiparticle calculations, the model Bethe--Salpeter equation (mBSE), and analytical descriptions of lattice-polarization effects. Across five tetragonal (P4/mmm) and monoclinic (Cm) structural models, the calculated exciton binding energies range from 140 to 210 meV. Chemical substitution modifies both the binding energies and the hydrogenic estimates of exciton spatial extent. By contrast, the structural distortion from tetragonal P4/mmm (D₄ₕ) to monoclinic Cm (Cₛ), which removes inversion and fourfold rotational symmetry, produces comparatively modest changes in binding energy but appreciably reshapes the real- and momentum-space exciton distributions. This contrast reveals a partial decoupling between exciton energetics and wavefunction geometry, and identifies a symmetry-associated sensitivity of exciton geometry to structural distortion. The changes are understood to occur together with modifications of local coordination and electronic dispersion, rather than as an isolated effect of symmetry alone. Lattice polarization provides an additional screening channel, reducing the estimated exciton binding energies by approximately 9--16%. Complementary Fröhlich-polaron calculations yield moderate mass enhancement and model-estimated electron-polaron mobilities of 39--99 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, with comparatively modest differences between the two polymorphs. These results highlight the distinct responses of exciton energetics, exciton wavefunction geometry, and carrier transport to chemical and structural modifications.

full_list.title_en: Lattice-geometry dependence of Type-I and Type-II magnetic flux responses in strongly correlated bosons

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superfluids and superconductors are classified into Type-I and Type-II according to their response to a magnetic flux, but this classification has hardly been addressed for lattice bosons under magnetic flux, where the Meissner and vortex phases have been studied mostly in ladder geometries. Here, we study the flux response of the extended Bose-Hubbard model with nearest-neighbor interaction V at half filling on square and triangular ladders with two to four legs by using the density-matrix renormalization group. On the square ladders, the vortex phase is confined to a region near V=0. At finite V, a magnetic flux-induced charge-density-wave (CDW) order replaces it, and the response becomes Type-I-like. In contrast, on the triangular ladders, the vortex phase persists over the whole range of V studied, and the response remains Type-II-like. By extrapolating the ladder results to two dimensions, we argue that the Type-I or Type-II character of the flux response depends on the lattice geometry, which suggests a role of geometric frustration.

full_list.title_en: Nonmonotonic Magnetic Correlations in Decorated Lieb-Lattice Anderson Models
full_list.title_zh: 装饰利布格子安德森模型中的非单调磁相关性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between electronic correlations and lattice geometry can strongly modify the competition between magnetic correlations and local singlet formation in multiorbital Hamiltonians. Here we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations to investigate two periodic Anderson-like models constructed by selectively hybridizing localized orbitals to the inequivalent sites of a Lieb lattice. The resulting geometries possess partially filled flat bands and different sublattice imbalances. We examine the evolution of local spin correlations and orbital-resolved magnetic structure factors as the hybridization is increased. Although correlations between hybridized orbitals evolve relatively smoothly toward local singlet formation, the longer-range magnetic correlations exhibit a striking nonmonotonic dependence on hybridization. In particular, we observe a pronounced suppression at intermediate hybridization followed by a substantial recovery on undecorated lattice sites. We discuss these results in relation to earlier studies of depleted periodic Anderson models and the constraints imposed by Lieb's theorem. Our findings illustrate how selective hybridization and flat-band structure can produce unusual redistributions of magnetic correlations in strongly interacting multiorbital systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子关联和晶格几何之间的相互作用可以强烈改变多轨道哈密顿量中磁关联和局部单线态形成之间的竞争。在这里，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究两个周期性类安德森模型，这些模型是通过选择性地将局域轨道与利布晶格的不等位点杂交而构建的。由此产生的几何形状具有部分填充的平带和不同的亚晶格不平衡性。我们研究了随着杂化程度的增加，局部自旋相关性和轨道分辨磁结构因素的演变。尽管杂化轨道之间的相关性相对平稳地朝着局部单线态形成发展，但较长程的磁相关性表现出对杂化的惊人的非单调依赖性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子关联和晶格几何之间的相互作用可以强烈改变多轨道哈密顿量中磁关联和局部单线态形成之间的竞争。在这里，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究两个周期性类安德森模型，这些模型是通过选择性地将局域轨道与利布晶格的不等位点杂交而构建的。由此产生的几何形状具有部分填充的平带和不同的亚晶格不平衡性。我们研究了随着杂化程度的增加，局部自旋相关性和轨道分辨磁结构因素的演变。尽管杂化轨道之间的相关性相对平稳地朝着局部单线态形成发展，但较长程的磁相关性表现出对杂化的惊人的非单调依赖性。特别是，我们观察到中间杂交的显着抑制，随后未修饰晶格位点的大幅恢复。我们结合早期对耗尽周期安德森模型的研究以及利布定理施加的约束来讨论这些结果。我们的研究结果说明了选择性杂化和平带结构如何在强相互作用的多轨道系统中产生不寻常的磁关联重新分布。

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Symmetry-Resolved Spectral Weight Reveals Charge Localization in Correlated Insulator
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.11879v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Can crystalline symmetry reveal where charge localizes in a strongly correlated insulator? We show that occupied symmetry-resolved spectral weights of the exact electronic Green's function define effective atomic limits. In an interacting Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain, their displacement tracks the spin-resolved many-body polarization across distinct insulating phases. A quantum metric of the one-body reduced density matrix provides a complementary geometric characterization. Our results extend real-space symmetry analysis beyond occupied-band projectors.

full_list.title_en: Topologically Obstructed Kondo Hybridization: A Route to Kondo Semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Topologically Obstructed Kondo Hybridization: A Route to Kondo Semimetals
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay of strong correlations, topology, and symmetry can reshape the low-energy electronic structure of quantum materials and drive the emergence of novel quantum phases. In heavy-fermion systems, the Kondo effect entangles localized f moments with conduction electrons, giving rise to coherent heavy-electron bands at low temperatures, typically characterized by a Kondo hybridization gap. Here we show, however, that the topology and symmetry of the conduction-electron Fermi surface can obstruct the opening of the Kondo hybridization gap at certain momenta. Treating the Fermi surface of a three-dimensional system as an effective two-dimensional manifold, we demonstrate that nontrivial topological invariants defined on this manifold impose a topological obstruction to opening a full hybridization gap, forcing the fc hybridization to vanish at certain momenta on the Fermi surface. These hybridization zeros lead to crossings between c and f bands, giving rise to nodal points or lines near the Fermi energy within the Kondo phase. Our results establish topological obstructions to Kondo hybridization as a route to Kondo semimetals, revealing a fundamental connection between Fermi-surface topology and the emergence of correlated electronic phases.

full_list.title_en: Transition-Metal Substitutions in MOF-5: A Hybrid-DFT Study of Oxygen Electrocatalysis
full_list.title_zh: MOF-5 中的过渡金属取代：氧电催化的混合 DFT 研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid density functional theory calculations were used to investigate the stability, electronic properties, and catalytic activity of transition-metal impurities substituting Zn sites (M(ᵣₘ Zₙ)) in the MOF-5 metal-organic framework [Zn(₄)O(BDC)(₃), BDC = 1,4-benzenedicarboxylate], with M = Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, and Cu. Most substitutions introduce (3d) states within the MOF-5 band gap and induce localized magnetic moments. Partially occupied (3d) states promote orbital hybridization and charge transfer with oxygenated intermediates, activating the dopant sites toward oxygen electrocatalysis. The oxygen reduction and evolution reaction (ORR and OER) activities were evaluated using the computational hydrogen electrode model. Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ) and Fe(ᵣₘ Zₙ) exhibit calculated ORR overpotentials of 0.57~V, while Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ) and Co(ᵣₘ Zₙ) yield OER overpotentials of 0.42 and 0.51~V, respectively, approaching those of benchmark precious-metal electrocatalysts. These findings identify Mn substitution as a promising strategy for achieving bifunctional ORR/OER activity in MOF-5 and establish a link between dopant electronic structure and catalytic performance to guide the design of MOF-based electrocatalysts.

full_list.title_en: When the magnetic force theorem fails: dressed exchange in the induced-moment magnets FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd
full_list.title_zh: 当磁力定理失效时：感应力矩磁体 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 中的交换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective spin Hamiltonians for itinerant magnets are commonly parameterized by magnetic-force-theorem (MFT) exchange constants, which are subsequently used to compute the behavior of complex and delicate spin textures, for example skyrmions. We show that for systems containing atoms with large spin susceptibility, such as Pd or Pt, this approach misses important parts of the energetics. For FePt, it even predicts the wrong ground state. Benchmarking against fully self-consistent spin-spiral density-functional calculations - in which the electronic structure, including the induced Pd/Pt moments, relaxes for every spin configuration - we quantify the missing energetics for the ordered L1₀ alloys FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd. By comparing a family of models that differ only in their treatment of the induced Pt moment, including the configuration-dependent models of Mryasov and Polesya, we identify the origin: the energetics of the induced moments are governed by the exchange-enhanced (dressed) susceptibility, of which the frozen-potential MFT captures only the bare part - about one third of the Pt-mediated interaction in FePt. We derive a general bound showing that no on-site (intra-atomic) refinement can supply the missing strength. The dressing decides the magnetic ground state in FePt, where the interlayer ordering rests entirely on the Pt-mediated interactions, and shifts the Curie temperatures of the other alloys by several hundred kelvin. Computed ordering temperatures, magnon spectra and spin wave stiffness for all four compounds are provided.
full_list.abstract_zh: 流动磁体的有效自旋哈密顿量通常由磁力定理 (MFT) 交换常数参数化，随后用于计算复杂而微妙的自旋纹理（例如斯格明子）的行为。我们表明，对于含有自旋敏感性较大的原子（例如 Pd 或 Pt）的系统，这种方法忽略了能量学的重要部分。对于 FePt，它甚至预测了错误的基态。对完全自洽的自旋螺旋密度泛函计算进行基准测试（其中电子结构，包括诱导的 Pd/Pt 矩，对于每种自旋配置都是松弛的），我们量化了有序 L1₀ 合金 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 缺失的能量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 流动磁体的有效自旋哈密顿量通常由磁力定理 (MFT) 交换常数参数化，随后用于计算复杂而微妙的自旋纹理（例如斯格明子）的行为。我们表明，对于含有自旋敏感性较大的原子（例如 Pd 或 Pt）的系统，这种方法忽略了能量学的重要部分。对于 FePt，它甚至预测了错误的基态。对完全自洽的自旋螺旋密度泛函计算进行基准测试（其中电子结构，包括诱导的 Pd/Pt 矩，对于每种自旋配置都是松弛的），我们量化了有序 L1₀ 合金 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 缺失的能量。通过比较仅在诱导 Pt 矩处理方面不同的一系列模型，包括 Mryasov 和 Polesya 的构型依赖模型，我们确定了起源：诱导矩的能量学由交换增强（修饰）磁化率控制，其中冻结电势 MFT 仅捕获裸露部分 - 约占 FePt 中 Pt 介导相互作用的三分之一。我们得出了一个一般界限，表明没有任何现场（原子内）细化可以提供缺失的强度。敷料决定了 FePt 中的磁性基态，其中层间排序完全取决于 Pt 介导的相互作用，并将其他合金的居里温度改变了数百开尔文。提供了所有四种化合物的计算有序温度、磁振子谱和自旋波刚度。

full_list.title_en: Chiral Spinterfaces as an Overlooked Component of the Chiral-Induced Spin Selectivity Effect
full_list.title_zh: 手性旋转面作为手性诱导自旋选择性效应中被忽视的组成部分
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.17608v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect is commonly associated with spin-selective transport through chiral molecules, while the role of molecule-electrode interfaces remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that adsorption of chiral amino acid derived molecules on ferromagnetic Ni films with native NiO layer induces a remanent chirality-dependent magneto-optical response. Systematic control experiments establish that this response originates from the molecule-NiO/Ni interface, rather than the molecular layer or bulk ferromagnet. First-principles calculations reveal preferential carboxylate binding and interfacial charge redistribution extending into the NiO surface layers, demonstrating how molecular adsorption modifies the electronic structure of the oxide. Together, these results provide evidence for the formation of chiral spinterfaces, where molecular chirality and interfacial electronic structure give rise to a distinct magnetic response. Our findings highlight the previously overlooked role of molecule-electrode interfaces in CISS-related systems and identify interfacial electronic and magnetic properties as important considerations for understanding and controlling spin selectivity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应通常与通过手性分子的自旋选择性传输有关，而分子-电极界面的作用仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们证明手性氨基酸衍生分子在具有天然 NiO 层的铁磁镍薄膜上的吸附会诱导剩余的手性依赖性磁光响应。系统控制实验表明，这种响应源自分子-NiO/Ni 界面，而不是分子层或块状铁磁体。第一原理计算揭示了优先的羧酸盐结合和界面电荷重新分布延伸到 NiO 表面层，展示了分子吸附如何改变氧化物的电子结构。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《手性旋转面作为手性诱导自旋选择性效应中被忽视的组成部分》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Topological phases protected by half-chiral symmetry
full_list.title_zh: 受半手性对称性保护的拓扑相
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26693v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral (or sublattice) symmetry describes bipartite systems such as the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain where same-sublattice A-A and B-B hoppings are forbidden, enabling the protection of topological phases. Here we identify new topological phases protected by half-chiral symmetry wherein chiral symmetry is preserved on only one sublattice, as may occur with sublattice imbalance (e.g. graphene-hBN) or localized orbitals (e.g. zincblende). Unlike conventional symmetry operators described by group theory, half-chiral symmetry is an algebraic constraint on the sublattice-projected Hamiltonian such as PHP=0, requiring a new framework for topological protection. We develop such a framework, identifying real-space bulk topological invariants and corresponding topological boundary modes that stick to zero energy. In two dimensions we construct a half-chiral Kekule honeycomb model and show that its unusual higher-order topology protects a single zero-energy mode at a single corner.
full_list.abstract_zh: 手性（或子晶格）对称性描述了二分系统，例如 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链，其中禁止同子晶格 A-A 和 B-B 跳跃，从而能够保护拓扑相。在这里，我们确定了受半手性对称性保护的新拓扑相，其中手性对称性仅保留在一个亚晶格上，这可能发生在亚晶格不平衡（例如石墨烯-六方氮化硼）或局域轨道（例如闪锌矿）中。与群论描述的传统对称算子不同，半手性对称是亚晶格投影哈密顿量的代数约束，例如 PHP=0，需要新的拓扑保护框架。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 手性（或子晶格）对称性描述了二分系统，例如 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链，其中禁止同子晶格 A-A 和 B-B 跳跃，从而能够保护拓扑相。在这里，我们确定了受半手性对称性保护的新拓扑相，其中手性对称性仅保留在一个亚晶格上，这可能发生在亚晶格不平衡（例如石墨烯-六方氮化硼）或局域轨道（例如闪锌矿）中。与群论描述的传统对称算子不同，半手性对称是亚晶格投影哈密顿量的代数约束，例如 PHP=0，需要新的拓扑保护框架。我们开发了这样一个框架，识别真实空间体拓扑不变量和相应的坚持零能量的拓扑边界模式。在二维中，我们构建了半手性凯库勒蜂窝模型，并表明其不寻常的高阶拓扑可以保护单个角上的单个零能量模式。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《受半手性对称性保护的拓扑相》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Tailoring Phonon Transport in Bi-based Quaternary Half-Heusler alloys for Thermoelectric Applications
full_list.title_zh: 用于热电应用的双基四元半霍斯勒合金中的声子传输定制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quaternary half-Heuslers (QHHs) are substitutionally disordered derivatives of conventional halfHeusler (HH) compounds, which offer a potential route to modify phonon transport and enhance thermoelectric performance. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric properties of the quaternary half-Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2, ZrHfIr2Bi2, Zr2RhIrBi2, and Hf2RhIrBi2 using first-principles calculations and anharmonic lattice dynamics. Among four compounds, ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2 exhibit semiconducting electronic structure and others are semimetallic in nature. Both the semiconducting compounds show favorable electronic transport properties. However, quaternary substitution substantially modifies the phonon dispersion, lowering the average phonon group velocity by about 17-22% relative to the parent compounds while leaving the anharmonic scattering rates comparable. The combination of high power factor and low kl results in high thermoelectric performance, with maximum ZT values of 2.28 and 2.18 at 1000 K for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2, respectively, with maximum thermoelectric power conversion efficiency 16.3% for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2. Further reducing the grain size enhances the thermoelectric performance, with maximum ZT values of 2.51 and 2.58 at 1000 K for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2, respectively, at a grain size of 30 nm. Our results demonstrate that combining substitutional disorder with grain boundary engineering, provides an effective strategy to enhance the thermoelectric performance of HH compounds.
full_list.abstract_zh: 四元half-Heusler (QHH) 是传统halfHeusler (HH) 化合物的替代无序衍生物，它提供了改变声子输运和增强热电性能的潜在途径。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和非谐晶格动力学研究了四元半 Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2、ZrHfIr2Bi2、Zr2RhIrBi2 和 Hf2RhIrBi2 的热电性质。四种化合物中，ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2表现出半导体电子结构，其他化合物本质上是半金属。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 四元half-Heusler (QHH) 是传统halfHeusler (HH) 化合物的替代无序衍生物，它提供了改变声子输运和增强热电性能的潜在途径。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和非谐晶格动力学研究了四元半 Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2、ZrHfIr2Bi2、Zr2RhIrBi2 和 Hf2RhIrBi2 的热电性质。四种化合物中，ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2表现出半导体电子结构，其他化合物本质上是半金属。这两种半导体化合物均表现出良好的电子传输特性。然而，四元取代显着改变了声子色散，相对于母体化合物，平均声子群速度降低了约 17-22%，同时保持非简谐散射率相当。高功率因数和低kl的结合导致了高热电性能，p型ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2在1000 K时的最大ZT值分别为2.28和2.18，p型ZrHfRh2Bi2的最大热电转换效率为16.3%。进一步减小晶粒尺寸可增强热电性能，晶粒尺寸为 30 nm 的 p 型 ZrHfRh2Bi2 和 Zr2RhIrBi2 在 1000 K 时的最大 ZT 值分别为 2.51 和 2.58。我们的结果表明，将取代无序与晶界工程相结合，为增强 HH 化合物的热电性能提供了一种有效的策略。

full_list.title_en: Artificial Spin-Glass of Antiferromagnetic Co3O4 Nanocubes Using Spin-Polarized Oxygen
full_list.title_zh: 使用自旋极化氧的反铁磁 Co3O4 纳米立方体的人工自旋玻璃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preferentially exposing (100) surface terminations of Co₃O₄ using cube-shaped nanoparticles yields an unconventional rearrangement of ions that generates spin-glass-like magnetism from the antiferromagnetic nanocubes. The necessary magnetic frustration arises out of competition between polarized Co-O bonds from charge transfer between O 2p and Co 3d orbitals, and highly anisotropic Co²⁺ ions combined with anomalous high spin Co³⁺ ions in octahedral sites. Size control permits tuning this novel combination of ions via preferentially polarizing Co-O bonds. The presence of control over frustrated magnetism among antiferromagnetic nanocubes yields an artificial spin glass platform for exploring unconventional nanomagnetism and engendering new opportunities for emerging technologies like spintronics and physical reservoir computing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 使用立方体形状的纳米粒子优先暴露 Co3O4 的 (100) 表面终端，产生非常规的离子重排，从而从反铁磁性纳米立方体产生旋转玻璃状的磁性。必要的磁挫败是由于 O 2p 和 Co 3d 轨道之间的电荷转移引起的极化 Co-O 键之间的竞争以及高度各向异性的 Co²⁺ 离子与八面体位点中异常高自旋 Co³⁺ 离子的结合而产生的。尺寸控制允许通过优先极化的 Co-O 键来调节这种新颖的离子组合。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用自旋极化氧的反铁磁 Co3O4 纳米立方体的人工自旋玻璃》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Frustration-Stabilized Hexamerons and Their Topological Magnons in Janus MXene
full_list.title_zh: Janus MXene 中的挫败稳定六聚体及其拓扑磁振子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frustrated magnets on triangular lattices favour noncollinear order, and when inversion symmetry is broken they can host localized topological textures on top of that order. Here we show that the Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI is such a system. Combining first-principles calculations with atomistic spin simulations, we find that magnetism is confined to the Mn layer, where a strong antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor exchange together with a sizable Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction stabilizes a frustrated 120 Neel ground state. On top of this ground state we identify a metastable hexameron: a composite of six merons and antimerons, one vortex-antivortex pair on each of the three sublattices, whose sublattice-resolved topological charges compensate. Linear spin-wave theory confirms that the hexameron is a local energy minimum, and its noncoplanar cores act as potential wells that bind discrete in-gap magnon modes below the bulk continuum. In a periodic hexameron array the magnon bands carry nonzero Chern numbers, and the resulting Berry curvature produces a magnon thermal Hall response whose sign depends on which of the two time-reversal partners of the hexameron is realized. Our results establish Janus MXenes as a two-dimensional platform in which frustration, broken inversion symmetry, and spin-orbit coupling combine to produce metastable antiferromagnetic solitons with distinct spectroscopic and transport fingerprints.
full_list.abstract_zh: 三角形晶格上的受挫磁体有利于非共线顺序，当反演对称性被打破时，它们可以在该顺序之上承载局部拓扑纹理。在这里，我们展示了 Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI 就是这样一个系统。将第一性原理计算与原子自旋模拟相结合，我们发现磁性仅限于 Mn 层，其中强烈的反铁磁最近邻交换以及相当大的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用稳定了受抑的 120 Neel 基态。

full_list.title_en: Growth and anisotropic directional dependent transport properties of Altermagnetic CrSb
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁 CrSb 的生长和各向异性方向依赖输运特性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CrSb is a metallic altermagnet exhibiting large momentum-dependent spin splitting and antifer- romagnetic ordering well above room temperature. Although its electronic and magnetotransport properties have attracted considerable attention, a systematic comparison of crystals prepared us- ing different growth methods remains limited. Here we investigate the structural, magnetic, and anisotropic transport properties of CrSb single crystals grown by Sb(self)-flux, Bi flux, and chem- ical vapor transport (CVT). Each of these growth reveals distinct crystal morphologies. Magne- tization measurements exhibit broadly consistent antiferromagnetic responses, with an additional low-temperature contribution observed in Bi-flux-grown crystals. All samples display metallic resis- tivity and positive, nonsaturating magnetoresistance up to 9 T. Sb-flux- and CVT-grown crystals exhibit comparable residual resistivity ratios and magnetoresistance, whereas Bi-flux-grown crys- tals show enhanced residual resistivity and a substantially reduced magnetoresistance, consistent with stronger carrier scattering. Hall measurements reveal a pronounced dependence on the field- current configuration, including nonlinear field dependence and opposite Hall polarities for different crystallographic orientations. These results establish the reproducibility of anisotropic magneto- transport across distinct growth routes while highlighting the sensitivity of carrier scattering to crystal-growth conditions. Our findings provide a comparative framework for selecting CrSb single crystals for orientation-dependent transport and spintronic investigations.
full_list.abstract_zh: CrSb 是一种金属交变磁体，在远高于室温的温度下表现出较大的动量相关自旋分裂和反铁磁有序性。尽管其电子和磁输运特性引起了相当大的关注，但对使用不同生长方法制备的晶体的系统比较仍然有限。在这里，我们研究了通过 Sb(自)-通量、Bi 通量和化学气相传输 (CVT) 生长的 CrSb 单晶的结构、磁性和各向异性传输特性。每一种生长都显示出不同的晶体形态。磁化测量表现出广泛一致的反铁磁响应，并在双助熔剂生长的晶体中观察到了额外的低温贡献。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: CrSb 是一种金属交变磁体，在远高于室温的温度下表现出较大的动量相关自旋分裂和反铁磁有序性。尽管其电子和磁输运特性引起了相当大的关注，但对使用不同生长方法制备的晶体的系统比较仍然有限。在这里，我们研究了通过 Sb(自)-通量、Bi 通量和化学气相传输 (CVT) 生长的 CrSb 单晶的结构、磁性和各向异性传输特性。每一种生长都显示出不同的晶体形态。磁化测量表现出广泛一致的反铁磁响应，并在双助熔剂生长的晶体中观察到了额外的低温贡献。所有样品都显示出金属电阻率和高达 9 T 的正非饱和磁阻。Sb 助熔剂和 CVT 生长的晶体表现出相当的残余电阻率比和磁阻，而双助熔剂生长的晶体则显示出增强的残余电阻率和显着降低的磁阻，这与更强的载流子散射一致。霍尔测量揭示了对场电流配置的明显依赖性，包括非线性场依赖性和不同晶体取向的相反霍尔极性。这些结果确立了不同生长路径上各向异性磁输运的可重复性，同时强调了载流子散射对晶体生长条件的敏感性。我们的研究结果为选择 CrSb 单晶进行取向依赖输运和自旋电子学研究提供了一个比较框架。

full_list.title_en: Impact of spin fluctuations on spectral functions and transport in a model altermagnet
full_list.title_zh: 自旋涨落对模型交流磁体中光谱函数和输运的影响
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding spin dependent transport in altermagnets is important for incorporating them in next generation spintronic technologies. Motivated by the discovery of altermagnetism in strongly correlated quantum materials, we explore this physics in the checkerboard lattice Hubbard model using a fermion Monte Carlo approach which tracks the full spatial dependence of spin fluctuations as a function of temperature. We present results for the evolution of the spin-dependent single particle spectral functions and transport as we go from the ordered ground state into the high temperature disordered paramagnetic phase. Our results could be tested in future spin-selective angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and spin transport experiments in candidate altermagnets realized in solid state quantum materials or in proposed ultracold atomic systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 了解交流磁体中的自旋相关输运对于将其纳入下一代自旋电子技术非常重要。受强相关量子材料中交变磁性发现的启发，我们使用费米子蒙特卡罗方法在棋盘格哈伯德模型中探索这种物理现象，该方法跟踪自旋波动作为温度函数的完整空间依赖性。我们提出了当我们从有序基态进入高温无序顺磁相时，自旋相关的单粒子光谱函数和输运演化的结果。我们的结果可以在未来的自旋选择角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和在固态量子材料或拟议的超冷原子系统中实现的候选交替磁体的自旋输运实验中进行测试。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《自旋涨落对模型交流磁体中光谱函数和输运的影响》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Parametric excitation of nano-scale spin waves with controlled phase by an open-resonator-type transducer
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Parametric excitation of nano-scale spin waves with controlled phase by an open-resonator-type transducer
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parametric excitation is one of the most effective methods for the excitation of nano-scale spin waves (SW) (or magnons) in magnetic films and nano-waveguides, as this method removes restrictions on the excited wave wavelength imposed by a finite width of the excitation transducer. Especially efficient parametric excitation of SW is achieved if the SW excitation is based on the effect of voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA). However, in a traditional parametric excitation process, the excited propagating waves have an arbitrary phase, which prevents the use of such waves in signal processing applications. Here, we demonstrate that the use of an VCMA transducer in the form of an open resonator with controlled partial reflections of waves at the boundaries allows one to excite SW having only two allowed phase states, controlled by the phase of the parametric pumping and reflections at the transducer boundaries. These reflections, also, lead to a reduced value of the parametric excitation threshold. In addition, micromagnetic simulations reveal the possibility to tune the phase distribution of the excited magnons using static voltage, which could be useful for applications in probabilistic computing.

full_list.title_en: Quantum Many-Body Scars from Operator Size
full_list.title_zh: 操作员尺寸的量子多体伤痕
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a general construction of approximate many-body scar states in two copies of a system using a bilocal size interaction that couples one site to its partner on the other copy. For an uncoupled two-sided Hamiltonian whose terms have fixed size in an operator basis, we identify polynomially many Krylov basis states that it annihilates and that, in the thermodynamic limit, become concentrated on a single size sector. The size operator splits them into a tower of equally spaced levels that gives rise to coherent revivals characterized by collective oscillations of energy across the two copies. We provide a concrete realization of this construction in two copies of a general q-body nearest-neighbor spin chain, and the SYK model.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用双局部大小相互作用，在系统的两个副本中提出了近似多体疤痕状态的一般构造，该双局部大小相互作用将一个位点与其在另一个副本上的伙伴耦合。对于一个未耦合的两侧哈密顿量，其项在算子基础上具有固定大小，我们确定多项式许多克雷洛夫基础状态，它会消失，并且在热力学极限下，集中在单个大小的扇区上。大小运算符将它们分成等距水平的塔，从而产生连贯的复兴，其特征是两个副本之间的能量集体振荡。我们在通用 q 体最近邻自旋链的两个副本和 SYK 模型中提供了这种结构的具体实现。

full_list.title_en: Quantum order by disorder among lozenge tilings: a staircase of hub-free crystals between the Lieb ferrimagnet and the antiferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 菱形瓷砖中的量子有序与无序：利布亚铁磁体和反铁磁体之间的无轮毂晶体阶梯
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lozenge tilings of the triangular lattice define an exponentially large family of bipartite networks, from the dice lattice, a Lieb ferrimagnet with the largest sublattice imbalance, to square-type tilings, which are compensated antiferromagnets. For the classical Heisenberg antiferromagnet all of them are degenerate. We show that quantum fluctuations lift this degeneracy through a local mechanism: the zero-point energy is, to leading order, a sum of site terms that are convex in the coordination z, so that Jensen's inequality at fixed langle zrangle=4 selects the square-type tiling. An expansion about the Ising limit explains the convexity: a site with more bonds has more channels for quantum fluctuations, but each fluctuation frustrates more bonds. A magnetic field couples to the Lieb moment and competes with this selection. Because the moment is carried most cheaply by threefold and fivefold sites, sixfold hubs are avoided, and bond counting together with the Lieb--Mattis theorem limits hub-free tilings to 3/5 of the dice moment. Quantum Monte Carlo and a complete enumeration of periodic tilings with small unit cells show that the classical jump is replaced by a staircase of periodic crystals. Its widest step is a hub-free crystal that saturates the bound; below it, threefold and fivefold defects pack ever more densely in a shallow sequence of crystals, controlled by a short-ranged attraction between defects of equal curvature and a repulsion between defects of opposite curvature. Selection energies scale as JS. In the height representation the coordination is the discrete Gaussian curvature and the Lieb moment its sublattice-staggered part. We give spectroscopic signatures and discuss realizations in nanographenes, atomic spin arrays and quantum simulators.
full_list.abstract_zh: 三角形晶格的菱形平铺定义了一个指数级大的二分网络家族，从骰子晶格（具有最大子晶格不平衡的利布亚铁磁体）到方形平铺（补偿反铁磁体）。对于经典的海森堡反铁磁体来说，它们都是简并的。我们证明，量子涨落通过局部机制提升了这种简并性：零点能量对于前导顺序来说是在配位 z 中凸的位点项之和，因此固定 langle zrangle=4 处的 Jensen 不等式选择了方形平铺。伊辛极限的扩展解释了凸性：具有更多键的位点具有更多的量子波动通道，但每次波动都会抑制更多的键。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 三角形晶格的菱形平铺定义了一个指数级大的二分网络家族，从骰子晶格（具有最大子晶格不平衡的利布亚铁磁体）到方形平铺（补偿反铁磁体）。对于经典的海森堡反铁磁体来说，它们都是简并的。我们证明，量子涨落通过局部机制提升了这种简并性：零点能量对于前导顺序来说是在配位 z 中凸的位点项之和，因此固定 langle zrangle=4 处的 Jensen 不等式选择了方形平铺。伊辛极限的扩展解释了凸性：具有更多键的位点具有更多的量子波动通道，但每次波动都会抑制更多的键。磁场与利布矩耦合并与这种选择竞争。因为三重和五重位点承载力矩的成本最低，所以避免了六重轮毂，并且键计数与利布-马蒂斯定理一起将无轮毂平铺限制为骰子矩的 3/5。量子蒙特卡罗和小晶胞周期性平铺的完整枚举表明，经典跳跃被周期性晶体的阶梯所取代。它最宽的台阶是一个无轮毂的晶体，饱和了边界；在它下面，三重和五重缺陷更加密集地堆积在浅层晶体序列中，受到相同曲率缺陷之间的短程吸引力和相反曲率缺陷之间的排斥的控制。选择能量尺度为 JS。在高度表示中，协调是离散高斯曲率，利布矩是其亚晶格交错部分。我们给出光谱特征并讨论纳米石墨烯、原子自旋阵列和量子模拟器的实现。
