full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《菱形瓷砖中的量子有序与无序：利布亚铁磁体和反铁磁体之间的无轮毂晶体阶梯》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Strain and Correlation Modulated Magnetic Anisotropy and Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interaction in 2D H-FeTe₂
full_list.title_zh: 二维 H-FeTe2 中的应变和相关调制磁各向异性以及 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.10477v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the ongoing research on two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnetic materials with strong intrinsic Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI), most efforts have focused on doping, Janus engineering, or heterostructure formation to break inversion symmetry and enhance spin--orbit coupling (SOC). Here, we demonstrate that a pristine 2D material, monolayer H-FeTe₂, can naturally host robust DMI and magnetic anisotropy due to its intrinsic broken inversion symmetry and the strong SOC of Te atoms. We explore the effect of biaxial strain and electron correlation on H-FeTe₂ using first-principles DFT+U calculations. We systematically investigate the Heisenberg exchange interaction, magnetic anisotropy, and DMI in the space spanned by strain and correlation. Our results reveal a distinct, non-monotonic strain dependence of both magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) and DMI, including a strain-tunable crossover between in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic easy axes. A remarkable enhancement of the in-plane DMI is observed under the combined influence of strain and strong correlations, which is unusual for pristine 2D materials and suggests a favorable regime for spintronic applications.Notably, even in the absence of strain, H-FeTe₂ exhibits finite DMI and considerable anisotropy, which is rare for a pure 2D material. Through these findings, we present H-FeTe₂ as a unique pristine 2D system with robust and tunable spin interactions for exploring fundamental spin--orbit-driven magnetic phenomena.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在对具有强本征 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 的二维 (2D) 铁磁材料正在进行的研究中，大多数努力都集中在掺杂、Janus 工程或异质结构形成上，以打破反演对称性并增强自旋轨道耦合 (SOC)。在这里，我们证明了一种原始的二维材料——单层 H-FeTe2，由于其固有的破缺反演对称性和 Te 原子的强 SOC，可以自然地具有强大的 DMI 和磁各向异性。我们使用第一性原理 DFT+U 计算探讨了双轴应变和电子关联对 H-FeTe2 的影响。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在对具有强本征 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) 的二维 (2D) 铁磁材料正在进行的研究中，大多数努力都集中在掺杂、Janus 工程或异质结构形成上，以打破反演对称性并增强自旋轨道耦合 (SOC)。在这里，我们证明了一种原始的二维材料——单层 H-FeTe2，由于其固有的破缺反演对称性和 Te 原子的强 SOC，可以自然地具有强大的 DMI 和磁各向异性。我们使用第一性原理 DFT+U 计算探讨了双轴应变和电子关联对 H-FeTe2 的影响。我们系统地研究了应变和相关性所跨越的空间中的海森堡交换相互作用、磁各向异性和 DMI。我们的结果揭示了磁各向异性能量 (MAE) 和 DMI 的明显的、非单调的应变依赖性，包括面内和面外磁易轴之间的应变可调交叉。在应变和强相关性的综合影响下，观察到面内 DMI 显着增强，这对于原始 2D 材料来说是不寻常的，并且表明了自旋电子应用的有利机制。值得注意的是，即使在没有应变的情况下，H-FeTe2 也表现出有限的 DMI 和相当大的各向异性，这对于纯 2D 材料来说是罕见的。通过这些发现，我们将 H-FeTe2 作为一种独特的原始二维系统，具有强大且可调节的自旋相互作用，可用于探索基本的自旋轨道驱动的磁现象。

full_list.title_en: Voltage-Controlled Dielectric Cavity Magnonics in Epitaxial Fe Films on SrTiO3 Single Crystal Substrates
full_list.title_zh: SrTiO3 单晶衬底上外延 Fe 薄膜中的压控介电腔磁振子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cavity magnonics relies on the hybridization between collective spin excitations and well-defined photonic or mechanical cavity modes, enabling fast and efficient coupling of spintronic devices to microwave circuits and optical information carriers. In this work, we present a hybrid material heterostructure that combines an intrinsic dielectric microwave cavity with a ferromagnetic medium, establishing magnon-photon interaction with coupling rates in the order of 0.1-1 GHz. Demonstrating effective voltage-control of the hybrid mode spectrum at cryogenic temperatures, we achieve a highly tunable photo-magnonic material, that could provide significant advancements for high-performance and power-efficient cryogenic RF-applications, including hybrid quantum technology, superconducting electronics and nonlinear microwave devices for unconventional computation and signal processing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 腔磁振子学依赖于集体自旋激发和明确的光子或机械腔模式之间的混合，从而实现自旋电子器件与微波电路和光学信息载体的快速有效耦合。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种混合材料异质结构，它将本征介电微波腔与铁磁介质相结合，以 0.1-1 GHz 量级的耦合率建立磁子-光子相互作用。通过展示低温下混合模式光谱的有效电压控制，我们实现了高度可调的光磁材料，可以为高性能和高能效的低温射频应用提供重大进步，包括混合量子技术、超导电子学和用于非常规计算和信号处理的非线性微波器件。

full_list.title_en: Local moment magnon spectrum in conduction electron tunnelling
full_list.title_zh: 传导电子隧道中的局域矩磁振子谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.05858v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The surface tunnelling spectrum of a dual system consisting of localised moments with antiferromagnetic order coupled to conduction electrons by on-site exchange interaction is investigated. In the static approximation of the local moment order it is known that magnetic band reconstruction leads to an anomalous tunnelling spectrum at the magnetic ordering vector of local moments although the latter cannot contribute directly. In this work we consider dynamic effects by including the scattering of conduction electrons from the local moment magnon excitations. They lead to self energies and renormalisation of conduction states which in turn appreciably modify the tunnelling spectrum beyond the influence of static order, interpreted as the appearance of magnon sidebands.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究了由具有反铁磁序的局域矩通过现场交换相互作用耦合到传导电子的双系统的表面隧道谱。在局部矩阶的静态近似中，已知磁带重建会导致局部矩的磁阶向量处的异常隧道谱，尽管后者不能直接贡献。在这项工作中，我们通过考虑来自局部矩磁振子激发的传导电子的散射来考虑动态效应。它们导致自能和传导态的重整化，这反过来又显着地改变了隧道谱，使其超出了静态顺序的影响，解释为磁振子边带的出现。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《传导电子隧道中的局域矩磁振子谱》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Lowering the temperature of two-dimensional fermionic tensor networks with cluster expansions
full_list.title_zh: 通过簇扩展降低二维费米子张量网络的温度
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.22113v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Representing the time-evolution operator as a tensor network constitutes a key ingredient in several algorithms for studying quantum lattice systems at finite temperature or in a non-equilibrium setting. For a Hamiltonian composed of strictly short-ranged interactions, the Suzuki-Trotter decomposition is the main technique for obtaining such a representation. In [B.~Vanhecke, L.~Vanderstraeten and F.~Verstraete, Physical Review A, L020402 (2021)], an alternative strategy, the cluster expansion, was introduced. This approach naturally preserves internal and lattice symmetries and can more easily be extended to higher-order representations or longer-ranged interactions. We extend the cluster expansion to two-dimensional fermionic systems, and employ it to construct projected entangled-pair operator (PEPO) approximations of Gibbs states. We also discuss and benchmark different truncation schemes for multiplying layers of PEPOs together. Applying the resulting framework to a two-dimensional spinless fermion model with attractive interactions, we resolve a clear phase boundary at finite temperature.
full_list.abstract_zh: 将时间演化算子表示为张量网络是研究有限温度或非平衡环境下量子晶格系统的多种算法的关键要素。对于由严格短程相互作用组成的哈密顿量，Suzuki-Trotter 分解是获得这种表示的主要技术。在 [B.~Vanhecke, L.~Vanderstraeten 和 F.~Verstraete, Physical Review A, L020402 (2021)] 中，引入了另一种策略，即集群扩展。

full_list.title_en: Deconfined criticality between an antiferromagnetic insulator and a nodal d-wave superconductor: a quantum Monte Carlo study
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体和节点 d 波超导体之间的解除临界临界性：量子蒙特卡罗研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.00762v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a quantum Monte Carlo study of the transition between the insulating Néel state and the nodal d-wave superconductor on the square lattice at half-filling. We access a regime of frustrated magnetic order without a sign problem using a parton representation of the electron in terms of fermionic spinons and bosonic chargons. Both partons move in a background π-flux (so the electron experiences no net flux) and are coupled to a quantum fluctuating SU(2) lattice gauge field. In contrast to earlier studies directly on the electronic degrees of freedom, we find evidence for a second-order deconfined quantum phase transition at which both the Néel and d-wave superconductivity orders vanish continuously. We compute correlators of the spinon-chargon composite with the same quantum numbers as the electron: we find a gapless Dirac dispersion inside the d-wave superconductor, turning into a gapped dispersion in the antiferromagnet.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《反铁磁绝缘体和节点 d 波超导体之间的解除临界临界性：量子蒙特卡罗研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Linear Response Theory of Nitrogen K-Edge X-ray Absorption of TCNQ
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Linear Response Theory of Nitrogen K-Edge X-ray Absorption of TCNQ
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The linear response of the density is computed in the frequency domain within the generalized Kohn--Sham framework of adiabatic time-dependent density functional theory, employing hybrid exchange-correlation functionals. It is shown that the generalized Casida equations imply a Dyson-like equation for the linear-response of the full frequency-dependent one-electron reduced density matrix of the reference GKS system. We implement this formalism in the textscCrystal code and apply it to the nitrogen K-edge near-edge X-ray absorption fine structure (NEXAFS) of 7,7,8,8-tetracyano-p-quinodimethane (TCNQ), the acceptor in the charge-transfer salt TTF-TCNQ. We interpret the spectrum through a step-by-step construction by building blocks of increasing complexity. This procedure separates the effects of π conjugation, of multiple equivalent absorbing centers and of the ring on the in-plane (π_parallel) and out-of-plane (π_perp) resonances. The theoretical result is confirmed by a comparison with angle-resolved experiments. In contrast with earlier assignments based only on the ground-state density of states, we find that the lowest-energy resonance is dominated by the ground-state KS LUMO contribution. Indeed, comparison with the independent-particle approximation shows that the exact-exchange contribution to the kernel is essential for a correct assignment of the peaks.

full_list.title_en: Neural variational Skyrmions as a topological benchmark: emergent symmetry, precision energies and KAN--MLP comparison
full_list.title_zh: 神经变分斯格明子作为拓扑基准：涌现对称性、精确能量和 KAN-MLP 比较
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27411v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose the three-dimensional Skyrme model as a topological benchmark for neural variational methods and construct fully three-dimensional Skyrmions with baryon number B=1,ldots,4 without imposing a symmetry ansatz, with high precision. For B=2,3,4, the relaxation of these Skyrmions starts from B unit-charge lumps with random positions and orientations, which carry no symmetry information. The known toroidal, tetrahedral, and cubic Skyrmions nevertheless emerge spontaneously. The resulting variational energies for B=1,ldots,4 lie slightly below the published reference values. The neural method highlights the high accuracy for retaining the topological charge, differing from B by at most 10⁻⁶ in the highest-precision solutions. Our numerical method goes through physical constraint tests such as the Derrick virial relation and the Faddeev--Bogomolny bound, together with evaluation / verification through independent quadratures and resolution sweeps. We then compare Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs) with multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in more than a thousand training runs, both with and without a rational-map ansatz. With default settings, KANs appear markedly superior, but most of the gap disappears once the MLP activation function and learning rate are tuned. KANs remain more parameter-efficient and more robust at fixed epoch budget, while MLPs with the tuned activation function perform at least as well at fixed wall-clock time. We also argue that continuous gradient descent cannot smoothly change the topological sector of our neural field, clarifying the origin of topological freezing observed in our neural variational solvers. Our results on the neural methods applied to Skyrmions pave a research ground for AI-agentic benchmarks for classical topological solitons, toward AI-assisted soliton physics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出三维 Skyrme 模型作为神经变分方法的拓扑基准，并构造具有重子数 B=1,ldots,4 的完全三维 Skyrmion，无需强加对称性 ansatz，具有高精度。对于 B=2,3,4，这些斯格明子的弛豫从具有随机位置和方向的 B 个单位电荷块开始，这些块不携带对称信息。尽管如此，已知的环形、四面体和立方斯格明子还是自发出现的。 B=1,ldots,4 的所得变分能量略低于公布的参考值。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《自旋交叉中性位钙钛矿铁电体》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Crystal structure, electrical resistivity, and electronic structure of single-crystal Ni₃Te₂》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《对称性指导寻找磁序》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Ultrafast excited state dynamics in 5-fluorouracil radical cation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Ultrafast excited state dynamics in 5-fluorouracil radical cation
full_list.abstract: 5-Fluorouracil (5FU) is a halogenated uracil analog widely used as a radiosensitizer in radiotherapy. Understanding its ionization and subsequent dynamics is essential for elucidating its role in radiation-induced damage mechanisms. In this work, we present a theoretical investigation of the nonadiabatic excited-state dynamics of ionized 5FU and discuss it in connection with a previous extreme-ultraviolet pump–probe experiment performed using high harmonic generation sources. The simulations are carried out using trajectory surface hopping dynamics combined with multireference complete active space self-consistent field electronic structure calculations to describe ultrafast electronic relaxation pathways. Motivated by the experimental conditions and hypotheses, we initiate the dynamics on the second excited state, D 2 , as well as higher-lying excited states up to D 5 . The computed radiationless decay lifetime from D 2 is very fast, in good agreement with the experimentally observed time constants. In contrast, the D 3 state exhibits comparatively slower relaxation, with a decay constant longer than 200 fs, exceeding those of both D 2 and D 5 . We further observe pronounced oscillatory population transfer between the D 1 and D 0 states, which provides a signature of the vibrational modes involved in the nonadiabatic transitions between these two states. Finally, we compare our results with previously reported theoretical uracil cation dynamics and find that 5FU shows a faster decay of the D 1 state compared to uracil. We also observe three ring-opening pathways during the dynamics, with C4–N3 bond cleavage being a more favorable pathway than C2–N1 and C2–N3.

full_list.abstract: Author(s): Atsuo Shitade and Naoto Nagaosa In the spin Hall effect, an electric field drives a transverse flow of spin that accumulates at the edges. Because spin current has no unique definition when spin-orbit coupling is present, the authors calculate here the spin accumulation coefficient instead, taking interband and impurity effects into account for Dirac electrons. As with the anomalous Hall effect, they find three regimes as the electric conductivity varies, including the dirty regime with a new scaling exponent of 0.6. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L291201] Published Mon Nov 23, 2026

full_list.title_en: A Negative-U Double Quantum Dot in a LaAlO3/SrTiO3 Membrane on Silicon
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Negative-U Double Quantum Dot in a LaAlO3/SrTiO3 Membrane on Silicon
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The development of freestanding oxide membranes creates new opportunities to integrate oxide functionalities with silicon technology. A central question is whether local gates can control the correlated electronic states of transferred membranes at the scale required for hybrid mesoscopic quantum devices. Here, we demonstrate local electrostatic control of freestanding LaAlO3/SrTiO3 (LAO/STO) membranes transferred onto silicon. In a dual-gated constriction in the interfacial electron system, we observe an oxide-based double quantum dot (DQD) in the regime of attractive on-site interactions (U < 0). Low-temperature transport reveals the characteristic honeycomb charge stability diagram, and spectroscopy identifies a paired-electron ground state at low magnetic fields, with odd-occupancy states becoming accessible above the pairing field. The observed transport spectra are reproduced by simulations within an attractive two site Hubbard model, and we extract the relevant DQD parameters, including intradot and interdot interactions, interdot tunnel coupling, and spin-orbit-assisted tunnel coupling. These findings establish oxide membranes as hosts for DQDs and extend coupled quantum dot systems into the regime of attractive on-site interactions.

full_list.title_en: A nonlinear transient finite element analysis of coupled solvent diffusion and large deformation of magneto-elastic hydrogel balloon
full_list.title_zh: 磁弹性水凝胶气球溶剂扩散与大变形耦合的非线性瞬态有限元分析
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27644v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study investigates the transient swelling of an initially spherical magnetoelastic hydrogel balloon. The balloon is inflated at constant internal pressure and exposed to the non-uniform magnetic field of one or two current-carrying coils. The gel is modelled as a compressible Ogden network mixed with solvent through Flory--Huggins theory, with an additive elastic--mixing--magnetic decomposition of the free energy. A fully coupled nonlinear finite element formulation uses a staggered solution scheme and a Taylor--Hood-type discretisation. It follows the balloon from its dry inflated state to either swollen equilibrium or burst. The formulation recovers the analytical free-swelling stretch and the delayed-burst regime, and its converged states agree with equilibrium energy minimisation. Symmetry-breaking (pear-shaped) dry configurations do not survive swelling: they rearrange rapidly and then relax by diffusion onto the symmetric branch. Transient membrane stresses can exceed their equilibrium values by nearly an order of magnitude. For coils which are sufficiently close to undeformed balloon, fields beyond a critical intensity close the slow-inflation curve into a loop. Stable swollen equilibria then exist only within a bounded pressure window that narrows as the field increases, and outside of it the balloon bursts. Under two coaxial coils, asymmetry about the equator appears only when the coils differ in current or radius. The magnetic field therefore acts as a control parameter for shape of balloon and permits or prevents stable swelling at a given pressure.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了最初球形磁致弹性水凝胶气球的瞬时膨胀。气球在恒定的内部压力下膨胀，并暴露于一个或两个载流线圈的不均匀磁场中。通过弗洛里-哈金斯理论，凝胶被建模为与溶剂混合的可压缩奥格登网络，并具有自由能的附加弹性-混合-磁分解。全耦合非线性有限元公式使用交错求解方案和 Taylor-Hood 型离散化。它跟随气球从干燥膨胀状态到膨胀平衡或破裂。该公式恢复了分析的自由膨胀拉伸和延迟爆发状态，并且其收敛状态与平衡能量最小化一致。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了最初球形磁致弹性水凝胶气球的瞬时膨胀。气球在恒定的内部压力下膨胀，并暴露于一个或两个载流线圈的不均匀磁场中。通过弗洛里-哈金斯理论，凝胶被建模为与溶剂混合的可压缩奥格登网络，并具有自由能的附加弹性-混合-磁分解。全耦合非线性有限元公式使用交错求解方案和 Taylor-Hood 型离散化。它跟随气球从干燥膨胀状态到膨胀平衡或破裂。该公式恢复了分析的自由膨胀拉伸和延迟爆发状态，并且其收敛状态与平衡能量最小化一致。对称破坏（梨形）的干燥构型无法在膨胀中幸存：它们迅速重新排列，然后通过扩散到对称分支上而松弛。瞬态膜应力可以超过其平衡值近一个数量级。对于足够接近未变形气球的线圈，超过临界强度的场将缓慢膨胀曲线闭合成环。稳定的膨胀平衡仅存在于有界压力窗口内，该压力窗口随着场的增加而变窄，而在该窗口之外，气球会破裂。在两个同轴线圈下，仅当线圈的电流或半径不同时，才会出现赤道不对称。因此，磁场充当球囊形状的控制参数，并允许或防止在给定压力下的稳定膨胀。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：自由能面和热力学积分/采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《磁弹性水凝胶气球溶剂扩散与大变形耦合的非线性瞬态有限元分析》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Annular Terahertz Near-Field of a Breathing Charged Vortex
full_list.title_zh: 呼吸带电涡旋的环形太赫兹近场
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the radial electric field around a singly quantized vortex in a charged BCS superconductor, when the Higgs amplitude mode is driven by a uniform terahertz (THz) electromagnetic pulse. In a local-density approximation the pairing gap vanishes on the vortex axis at all times, so the particle density on the axis cannot oscillate, whereas the curvature of the density profile around the axis does. Starting from the electrostatic-lens formalism of our previous work, we show that this converts the electrically neutral Higgs oscillation into an alternating radial electric field that vanishes on the axis. When the electrostatic screening length is much shorter than the vortex core, we obtain the field in closed form: it has a ring-shaped profile, with a maximum at a distance of the order of the coherence length from the axis, and the Higgs drive modulates it by a fraction 2η, where η is the relative oscillation of the gap. For niobium nitride and η=0.1 the static field of the vortex is about 140~V/m and its modulation about 30~V/m, independently of the carrier density and of the dielectric constant. We also discuss how the thermodynamic factor entering the field changes toward the BCS-BEC crossover.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当希格斯振幅模式由均匀太赫兹 (THz) 电磁脉冲驱动时，带电 BCS 超导体中单量子化涡旋周围的径向电场。在局部密度近似中，涡旋轴上的配对间隙始终消失，因此轴上的粒子密度不能振荡，而绕轴的密度分布的曲率却会振荡。从我们之前工作的静电透镜形式开始，我们证明这将电中性希格斯振荡转换为在轴上消失的交变径向电场。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了当希格斯振幅模式由均匀太赫兹 (THz) 电磁脉冲驱动时，带电 BCS 超导体中单量子化涡旋周围的径向电场。在局部密度近似中，涡旋轴上的配对间隙始终消失，因此轴上的粒子密度不能振荡，而绕轴的密度分布的曲率却会振荡。从我们之前工作的静电透镜形式开始，我们证明这将电中性希格斯振荡转换为在轴上消失的交变径向电场。当静电屏蔽长度比涡核短得多时，我们获得闭合形式的场：它具有环形轮廓，最大值位于距轴相干长度数量级的位置，希格斯驱动器将其调制为分数 2η，其中 η 是间隙的相对振荡。对于氮化铌且 η=0.1，涡流的静态场约为 140V/m，其调制约为 30V/m，与载流子密度和介电常数无关。我们还讨论了进入该领域的热力学因素如何朝着 BCS-BEC 交叉方向变化。

full_list.title_en: Atomic layer etching of niobium via alternating O₂ and H₂/SF₆ plasma exposures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Atomic layer etching of niobium via alternating O₂ and H₂/SF₆ plasma exposures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Niobium thin films are a key component of superconducting detectors and electronics, and film surface quality, surface roughness, and geometrical dimensional accuracy affect many performance metrics. Atomic layer etching (ALE) is of interest for modifying film surfaces owing to its Angstrom-scale etching precision and surface smoothing characteristics. Here, we report a plasma-enhanced ALE process for Nb based on sequential O₂ plasma and H₂/SF₆ plasma exposures. The process achieves an etch per cycle of 5-7 Angstrom/cycle and exhibits surface smoothing. The superconducting transition temperature of the ALE-treated films is maintained up to the expected decrease associated with reduced film thickness. Our ALE process could find applications in superconducting electronics for which surface quality and precise thickness control are of high importance.

full_list.title_en: Atomistic theory of the d-wave phonon angular momentum splitter effect
full_list.title_zh: d波声子角动量分裂效应的原子理论
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonons offer a bosonic route to angular-momentum transport in solids, but how their momentum-space textures manifest in transport remains unclear. Here we develop an atomistic theory of the phonon angular momentum splitter effect in an antiferromagnetic square lattice with checkerboard-modulated elastic couplings, analogous to the spin-splitter effect in d-wave altermagnets. We calculate the transport and accumulation of phonon angular momentum driven by a temperature gradient and find that the transverse response separates into Hall and dₓy-wave splitter contributions. The splitter contribution requires both the antiferromagnetic order and the checkerboard elastic modulation and exhibits a characteristic dₓy angular dependence, whereas the Hall contribution is nearly isotropic. Their combination enables directional control of the edge phonon angular momentum accumulation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 声子为固体中的角动量输运提供了一条玻色子途径，但它们的动量空间纹理在输运中如何体现仍不清楚。在这里，我们开发了具有棋盘调制弹性耦合的反铁磁方晶格中声子角动量分裂器效应的原子理论，类似于 d 波交流磁体中的自旋分裂器效应。我们计算了温度梯度驱动的声子角动量的传输和累积，发现横向响应分为霍尔和 dₓy 波分束器贡献。分束器的贡献需要反铁磁阶和棋盘弹性调制，并表现出特征 dₓy 角度依赖性，而霍尔贡献几乎是各向同性的。它们的组合能够对边缘声子角动量积累进行定向控制。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《d波声子角动量分裂效应的原子理论》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Chemical Programming of Stacking Order and Superconductivity Dimensionality in NbSe2-xTex Polytypic Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Chemical Programming of Stacking Order and Superconductivity Dimensionality in NbSe2-xTex Polytypic Heterostructures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered transition-metal dichalcogenides exhibit electronic states highly sensitive to lattice symmetry, yet elucidating the structure-superconductivity relationship has been challenging due to the lack of a continuous structural evolution within a single material system. Here, we establish NbSe2-xTex as a model system, where Te substitution drives a sequential polytypic transition across the full composition range-from the low-Te 2H phase, through mixed 1H/1T heterostructured 4H and 6R polytypes at intermediate substitution, to ideal 1T and distorted 1T' structures at high Te content. Combining comprehensive characterizations, we map both the structural evolution and the accompanying changes in spectral weight and orbital character near the Fermi level. Electrical transport measurements reveal a striking phase-dependent superconducting dimensionality: the 4H phase (NbSe1.4Te0.6) exhibits enhanced anisotropy and an anomalous boost in the in-plane upper critical field, while the 6R phase (NbSe1.2Te0.8)shows suppressed Tc (~ 2.8 K) and three-dimensional-like behavior. The combined electronic-structure and superconducting results connect the stacking sequence to effective interlayer coherence and the local spin-orbit environment. SOC band calculations resolve the distinct symmetry constraints on the 4H and 6R electronic states. These mechanisms fundamentally differ from conventional approaches by leveraging intrinsic, composition-driven polytypism to modify interlayer coupling and band structure. Thus, by establishing a definitive phase diagram that directly correlates polytypism with superconducting dimensionality, our work provides a clear roadmap for the rational design of low-dimensional superconducting devices through stacking-sequence engineering.

full_list.title_en: Emergent Long-Range Entanglement in the XXZ Quantum Spin Chain with Competing Orders
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent Long-Range Entanglement in the XXZ Quantum Spin Chain with Competing Orders
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competition between short-range and long-range interactions is a largely unexplored route to one-dimensional quantum matter. We introduce a spin-1/2 XXZ chain with ferromagnetic nearest-neighbour and antiferromagnetic power-law couplings. Using DMRG and spin-wave theory, we show this competition stabilises a gapless phase with central charge c=0.997(17), a twofold-degenerate ground state and entanglement spectrum, absent in nearest-neighbour models, and is long-range entangled as diagnosed by finite quantum conditional mutual information. The model also generates a unique gapped quantum phase and gapless antiphase with non-decaying correlations.

full_list.title_en: Evidence for itinerant electron-local moment interaction in Li-doped α-MnTe
full_list.title_zh: 锂掺杂 α-MnTe 中巡回电子局域矩相互作用的证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.00747v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use inelastic neutron scattering (INS) and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to study the impact of Li doping on the semiconducting altermagnet α-MnTe. Introducing Li reorients the ordered moment direction from in-plane to out-of-plane and increases the density of itinerant carriers. While our ARPES measurements do not indicate any notable doping-induced changes in the electronic band structure or the magnitude of the altermagnetic band splitting, our INS measurements reveal an abrupt doping-induced decrease in the spin-wave lifetime near the zone boundary at high energies. This finding is consistent with a new magnon decay channel driven by subtle, doping-induced changes in the band structure and enhanced interactions between Mn²⁺ local moments and itinerant electrons. By extracting the local dynamic susceptibility from INS spectra and applying the total moment sum rule, we find that both undoped and Li-doped α-MnTe exhibit a nearly full expected Mn²⁺ local moment of approx5.9~μ_B with S=5/2. These findings suggest that α-MnTe hosts robust local-moment altermagnetism which shows a breakdown at high energies upon addition of itinerant carriers, highlighting the importance of carrier-spin coupling in magneto-transport and spin dynamics of altermagnets, even in the dilute-carrier limit.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用非弹性中子散射（INS）和角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）来研究Li掺杂对半导体交流磁体α-MnTe的影响。 Li的引入将有序力矩方向从面内重新定向到面外，并增加了流动载流子的密度。虽然我们的 ARPES 测量没有表明电子能带结构或交磁能带分裂幅度有任何明显的掺杂引起的变化，但我们的 INS 测量揭示了高能区域边界附近的掺杂引起的自旋波寿命的突然减少。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用非弹性中子散射（INS）和角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）来研究Li掺杂对半导体交流磁体α-MnTe的影响。 Li的引入将有序力矩方向从面内重新定向到面外，并增加了流动载流子的密度。虽然我们的 ARPES 测量没有表明电子能带结构或交磁能带分裂幅度有任何明显的掺杂引起的变化，但我们的 INS 测量揭示了高能区域边界附近的掺杂引起的自旋波寿命的突然减少。这一发现与新的磁振子衰变通道是一致的，该衰变通道是由掺杂引起的能带结构的微妙变化以及 Mn²⁺ 局部矩和流动电子之间增强的相互作用驱动的。通过从INS谱中提取局部动态磁化率并应用总矩和规则，我们发现未掺杂和Li掺杂的α-MnTe均表现出几乎完全预期的Mn²⁺局部矩，约为5.9~μ_B，其中S=5/2。这些发现表明，α-MnTe 具有强大的局域矩交变磁性，在添加流动载流子后会在高能量下表现出击穿，这凸显了载流子自旋耦合在交变磁体的磁输运和自旋动力学中的重要性，即使在稀载流子极限下也是如此。

full_list.title_en: Free-Space Excitation of Frozen Waves and Topological Edge States in Graphene at a Time Interface
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Free-Space Excitation of Frozen Waves and Topological Edge States in Graphene at a Time Interface
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.26714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-varying two-dimensional materials, such as graphene under ultrafast photoexcitation, offer a promising platform for engineering temporal interfaces for electromagnetic waves. Rapidly promoting valence electrons to the conduction band generates a high-energy, non-thermal hot-electron population that subsequently thermalizes with the pre-existing thermal electron population. We study the excitation of plasmonic modes in graphene by the time interface created by ultra-fast photoexcitation using a graphene electron-transport model that is self-consistently coupled to electromagnetic simulations. We find that in addition to dynamic, propagating plasmonic modes, the time interfaces result in the excitation of static, spatially varying electromagnetic modes in the interaction region sustained by streaming transverse electrons. We also demonstrate a novel technique for coupling free-space light directly to highly localized topological edge states at the magnetic-inversion boundary on graphene, eliminating the need for near-field excitation techniques.

full_list.title_en: Gap-label bounds and optical reconstruction of Landau-subband quantum geometry
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Gap-label bounds and optical reconstruction of Landau-subband quantum geometry
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a magnetic gap-label lower bound on the internal quantum weight of Landau subbands that remains nonzero even when the occupied Chern number vanishes. Using the second fundamental forms of nested subbundles to decompose the quantum geometric tensor, we isolate the constraint imposed by the uniform parent curvature and show that the excess quantum weight above the bound equals twice the weaker circular transition weight. For a noninteracting parabolic band with a periodic scalar potential, Landau-level mixing preserves the integrated relative curvature while the occupied direct gap remains open. Nevertheless, uncorrected sub-cyclotron absorption need not satisfy the projected bound. Using exact circular-dipole relations, we reconstruct the low-frequency guiding-centre weight and signed dichroism from circularly polarized absorption. This reconstruction removes the first-order orbit-polarization contribution. For an insulating filling of an isolated lowest-Landau-level-derived cluster, a potential-gradient estimate bounds the omitted remote-transition weight quadratically at weak coupling. This yields a finite-window lower bound on reconstructed quantum weight and bounds the deviation of reconstructed dichroism from the integrated relative curvature.

full_list.title_en: General Transport Signatures of Odd-Parity Magnets: Charge--Spin Selection Rules and Temporal--Spectral Separation
full_list.title_zh: 奇宇称磁体的一般输运特征：电荷-自旋选择规则和时间-光谱分离
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.27763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While even-parity altermagnets are known for spatially separating charge and spin currents via the crystal spin Hall effect, the defining transport counterpart for odd-parity magnets remains to be established. Here, we establish temporal and spectral charge--spin separation as a general transport signature across all spin-splitting classes of collinear and noncollinear odd-parity magnets with unitary spin-flip inversion mathcal U=[C₂^perpVert P]. This symmetry restricts charge responses to odd orders and z-polarized spin responses to even orders, independent of microscopic mechanism and without requiring spin conservation. For ac drives that reverse sign after half a period, charge and spin currents exhibit opposite half-period parities, and their spectra contain only odd charge and even spin harmonics. This allows dc spin rectification without a dc charge counterpart, even in longitudinal transport and beyond weak fields. We show that although antiunitary mathcal Tτ enforces odd-parity bands, it reverses the charge--spin selection of Berry-curvature and Berry-curvature-dipole responses, providing a direct transport fingerprint distinguishing the two protecting symmetries. We verify the selection rules for all linear and second-order transport mechanisms and demonstrate harmonic separation in a minimal odd-parity model, representative Floquet-engineered collinear MnPS₃, and the equilibrium noncollinear VCl₂ family.
full_list.abstract_zh: 虽然偶宇称互变磁体因通过晶体自旋霍尔效应在空间上分离电荷和自旋电流而闻名，但奇宇称磁体的定义传输对应物仍有待建立。在这里，我们将时间和光谱电荷-自旋分离建立为共线和非共线奇宇称磁体的所有自旋分裂类的一般输运特征，具有单一自旋翻转反转数学 U=[C2^perpVert P]。这种对称性将电荷响应限制为奇数级，将 z 极化自旋响应限制为偶数级，与微观机制无关，并且不需要自旋守恒。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 虽然偶宇称互变磁体因通过晶体自旋霍尔效应在空间上分离电荷和自旋电流而闻名，但奇宇称磁体的定义传输对应物仍有待建立。在这里，我们将时间和光谱电荷-自旋分离建立为共线和非共线奇宇称磁体的所有自旋分裂类的一般输运特征，具有单一自旋翻转反转数学 U=[C2^perpVert P]。这种对称性将电荷响应限制为奇数级，将 z 极化自旋响应限制为偶数级，与微观机制无关，并且不需要自旋守恒。对于半周期后符号反转的交流驱动器，电荷和自旋电流表现出相反的半周期奇偶性，并且它们的频谱仅包含奇数电荷和偶数自旋谐波。即使在纵向传输和弱场之外，这也允许在没有直流电荷对应物的情况下进行直流自旋整流。我们表明，尽管反酉数学 Tτ 强制了奇宇称带，但它逆转了 Berry 曲率和 Berry 曲率偶极子响应的电荷自旋选择，提供了区分两种保护对称性的直接传输指纹。我们验证了所有线性和二阶输运机制的选择规则，并演示了最小奇宇称模型、代表性 Floquet 设计的共线 MnPS₃ 和平衡非共线 VCl2 系列中的谐波分离。

core_items.title_en: Generating grain boundary structures at a specified energy with a symmetry-constrained diffusion model
core_items.title_zh: 使用对称约束扩散模型在指定能量下生成晶界结构
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.27188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) govern many properties of polycrystalline materials, and inverse design would make the GB structure itself a design variable. Crystal generative models such as MatterGen operate on periodic cells, which contain two GBs. The cell energy defines a single GB only when the two are equivalent, but existing models do not enforce this equivalence. Building on MatterGen, we developed a symmetry-constrained diffusion model in which the two GBs are related by a symmetry operation: atoms near one GB are generated, and those near the other are reconstructed through a symmetry projection applied at every denoising step. We applied it to the Σ 5(210)[001] symmetric tilt GB in Al, conditioning generation on the GB energy from a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). All 350 generated structures kept a geometrically equivalent GB pair after relaxation. Given a target GB energy, the model generated structures at that energy: for the three in-range targets with many nearby training structures, 44% to 70% fell within ± 0.1 J/m² of the target. Tracking weakened at higher energies and failed outside the training range. Of the 91 near-target structures, 90 matched no training structure under the adopted geometric criterion, indicating that the model can propose configurations near the target energy that are distinct from the training structures, a capability that could help identify unknown metastable GB structures observed in experiments. Building GB-pair equivalence into generation thus makes GB properties well-defined design targets, enabling inverse design of GB structures.
core_items.abstract_zh: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。我们将其应用于 Al 中的 Σ 5(210)[001] 对称倾斜 GB，通过机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 调节 GB 能量的生成。所有 350 个生成的结构在松弛后都保持几何等效的 GB 对。给定目标 GB 能量，模型会生成该能量的结构：对于具有许多附近训练结构的三个范围内目标，44% 到 70% 落在目标的 ± 0.1 J/m² 范围内。跟踪在较高能量下减弱，并且在训练范围之外失败。在 91 个接近目标的结构中，有 90 个在采用的几何标准下与训练结构不匹配，这表明该模型可以提出与训练结构不同的目标能量附近的配置，这种能力可以帮助识别在实验中观察到的未知亚稳态 GB 结构。将 GB 对等价性构建到生成中，从而使 GB 属性成为明确定义的设计目标，从而实现 GB 结构的逆向设计。
core_items.summary: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用对称约束扩散模型在指定能量下生成晶界结构》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Recovering from Averages: An Inverse Problem Perspective on Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
core_items.title_zh: 从平均值中恢复：机器学习原子间势的反问题视角
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.26819v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate the potential energy surface of atomistic systems from quantum-mechanical reference data and enable molecular simulation at near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Since they are fitted to total energies and forces, it is not obvious what is estimated: the total energy or the many-body potentials from which it is assembled. Mathematically, this can be formulated as a question whether a function can be recovered from averages of its values over random clusters. We study it for a linear model of fixed correlation order in simplified statistical setting. We show that, in the population limit, the potential is identifiable in a natural weighted Sobolev space, and derive finite-sample recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments for pair, three-body, and four-body models support the theory.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 根据量子力学参考数据近似计算原子系统的势能表面，并以接近从头算的精度实现分子模拟，且成本仅为一小部分。由于它们是根据总能量和力拟合的，因此估计的内容并不明显：总能量或多体势。从数学上讲，这可以表述为一个问题：函数是否可以从随机簇上的平均值中恢复。我们研究了简化统计设置中固定相关阶数的线性模型。我们证明，在人口限制下，潜力在自然加权索博列夫空间中是可识别的，并得出有限样本恢复保证。成对、三体和四体模型的数值实验支持了该理论。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《从平均值中恢复：机器学习原子间势的反问题视角》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Sampling non-abelian lattice gauge theories with diffusion models
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Sampling non-abelian lattice gauge theories with diffusion models
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.27821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present gauge-equivariant diffusion models as samplers for lattice gauge theories (LGTs). Using lattice gauge-equivariant convolutional neural networks (L-CNNs) and the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm (MAALA), we are able to accurately sample two-dimensional U(2) field configurations and show first promising results for four-dimensional SU(3). Our two-dimensional models extrapolate remarkably well to larger inverse couplings than originally trained on. We confirm this by comparing observables to analytically known values and to hybrid Monte Carlo results.

core_items.title_en: Role of antisite disorder in dictating the Ising anisotropy and ferromagnetic ground state of NdGaSi
core_items.title_zh: 反位无序在决定 NdGaSi 伊辛各向异性和铁磁基态中的作用
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.27334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions together set the magnetic ground state of rare-earth intermetallics, yet the role of chemical disorder on the ligand sublattice remains little explored. Here, we show that Ga/Si antisite disorder in NdGaSi stabilises the centrosymmetric I4₁/amd structure and raises the Nd³⁺ site symmetry to D₂d, which forbids all m=±2 Stevens operators in the crystalline electric field (CEF) Hamiltonian. Magnetization, specific heat, single-crystal neutron diffraction, and x-ray absorption spectroscopy establish the disordered structure and a collinear ferromagnetic order below T_Capprox11~K with Ising anisotropy along c. A CEF analysis that fits the susceptibilities along both axes and the magnetic specific heat simultaneously yields a ground-state doublet that is sim97% pure, in contrast to the strongly mixed ground state of the Al/Si-ordered NdAlSi (C₂ᵥ site symmetry of Nd³⁺). We argue that this ground-state purity makes the ordered moment rigid against the modulation due to frustrated exchange, selecting a k=0 ferromagnet in NdGaSi instead of the incommensurate ferrimagnet of NdAlSi. Antisite disorder, thus, acts as a handle on CEF ground-state purity and can, thereby, select between fundamentally different magnetic ground states.
core_items.abstract_zh: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。 CEF 分析同时拟合沿两个轴的磁化率和磁比热，产生纯度为 sim97% 的基态双峰，这与 Al/Si 有序 NdAlSi 的强混合基态（Nd3⁺ 的 C2ᵥ 位点对称）形成鲜明对比。我们认为，由于交换受阻，这种基态纯度使得有序矩对调制变得刚性，选择 k=0 的 NdGaSi 铁磁体而不是 NdAlSi 的不相称亚铁磁体。因此，反位点无序充当 CEF 基态纯度的手柄，从而可以在根本不同的磁性基态之间进行选择。

core_items.title_zh: E2Former-V3：原子角色感知等变原子间势
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.27111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials approach density-functional accuracy, but explicit-solvent atom counts are dominated by hydrogens and water. Uniform equivariant architectures still give every atom the same latent width and number of expensive block updates. To our knowledge, no prior method reallocates capacity by chemical role while retaining every atom and its first-principles force. We introduce E2Former-V3, which treats capacity as an atom-level resource: a static chemical role, assigned before the backbone runs, sets each atom's latent width and update count. No atom is removed, no coordinate is integrated out, and every force remains the gradient of one conservative energy. Standard reduces only the update count, sending hydrogen through half as many full-width block updates; on OMol25 validation it reaches a force mean absolute error (MAE) of 8.146 meV/Angstrom, against E2Former-V2's published 8.38, at 1.75-1.84x V2's throughput with lower peak memory on one H200. Flash also narrows the low-resolution stream to one eighth of the high-resolution width (32 vs 256 channels) and routes water oxygen with hydrogen, reaching 4.00-4.88x on three solvated systems (up to 5.85x in the pure-water all-low-resolution limit) at 11.272 meV/Angstrom, trading force accuracy for speed. Across 54 20 ps MD legs, a 100 ps NVE check, and a 1 ns NVT run on a 32,437-atom solvated protein, all runs complete; the MD legs show no non-finite values, clashes, or water fusion, and water O-O and Na-O RDF peak positions match experiment within 0.04 Angstrom. E2Former-V3 therefore moves the accuracy-throughput frontier for all-atom, conservative simulation, not a uniform accuracy win: Standard is worse on biomolecules and metals, better on electrolytes and organics; energy MAE is higher than E2Former-V2's; and water densities remain about 7.5% too high. Code: https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM.

core_items.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习的原子间势接近密度泛函精度，但显式溶剂原子计数以氢和水为主。统一的等变架构仍然为每个原子提供相同的潜在宽度和昂贵的块更新数量。据我们所知，现有方法还没有通过化学作用重新分配容量，同时保留每个原子及其第一原理力。我们引入了 E2Former-V3，它将容量视为原子级资源：在主干运行之前分配的静态化学角色，设置每个原子的潜在宽度和更新计数。没有原子被移除，没有坐标被积分，并且每个力仍然是一个保守能量的梯度。标准仅减少更新计数，通过一半的全角块更新发送氢；在 OMol25 验证中，它达到了 8.146 meV/Angstrom 的力平均绝对误差 (MAE)，而 E2Former-V2 发布的值为 8.38，吞吐量为 V2 的 1.75-1.84 倍，并且一台 H200 上的峰值内存较低。 Flash 还将低分辨率流缩小到高分辨率宽度的八分之一（32 通道与 256 通道），并用氢传输水氧，在 11.272 meV/Angstrom 下在三个溶剂化系统上达到 4.00-4.88 倍（在纯水全低分辨率极限中高达 5.85 倍），以力精度换取速度。在 32,437 个原子溶剂化蛋白上运行 54 个 20 ps MD 腿、100 ps NVE 检查和 1 ns NVT，所有运行均已完成； MD腿没有表现出非有限值、冲突或水融合，并且水O-O和Na-O RDF峰位置与实验匹配在0.04埃以内。因此，E2Former-V3 移动了全原子保守模拟的精度吞吐量前沿，而不是统一的精度胜利：标准在生物分子和金属方面较差，在电解质和有机物方面较好；能量MAE高于E2Former-V2；水密度仍然高出约 7.5%。代码：https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示、第一性原理标注与结构优化。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《E2Former-V3：原子角色感知等变原子间势》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Probabilistic physics-informed neural solvers for Woods–Saxon parameter identification: a coupled forward–inverse approach
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Probabilistic physics-informed neural solvers for Woods–Saxon parameter identification: a coupled forward–inverse approach
core_items.abstract: We introduce a probabilistic physics-informed learning framework that couples quantum-state reconstruction with dataset-level identification of globally shared Hamiltonian parameters from bound-state spectra. The Woods–Saxon inverse problem provides a physically interpretable test case involving multiple nuclei, neutron and proton sectors, and Coulomb and spin–orbit contributions. WaveNet represents separated radial, polar, and azimuthal wavefunction components, while ParamNet combines normalized radial probes, observed energies, nuclear descriptors, and quantum numbers to infer a distribution over six global parameters. Training jointly enforces Rayleigh-energy consistency, separated Schrödinger residuals, boundary and phase conditions, explicit normalization, selective orthogonality, spin–orbit splitting consistency, and Kullback–Leibler regularization. The physics-informed formulation supports learning from limited spectral observations without supervised wavefunction labels, using only experimental energies from four nuclei. Spectral evaluation uses the physical-space distribution mean. The learned standard deviations describe model-dependent parameter variability. In synthetic closure tests, all six generating parameters are recovered with sub-percent relative errors. Reintroducing the inferred means into an independent finite-difference (FD) solver gives spectral mean absolute errors of for the Seminole parameterization and for Wahlborn. For experimental spectra, the inferred Seminole interaction gives an aggregate mean absolute error of , compared with for the reference interaction and for a FD least-squares fit using the same identification levels. Identification within the Wahlborn expression reduces the corresponding error from to . The framework provides a reusable and robust scientific-machine-learning formulation for inverse quantum eigenvalue problems in which globally shared parameters and physically constrained states must be identified jointly.
core_items.summary: We introduce a probabilistic physics-informed learning framework that couples quantum-state reconstruction with dataset-level identification of globally shared Hamiltonian parameters from bound-state…
core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Probabilistic physics-informed neural solvers for Woods–Saxon parameter identification: a coupled forward–inverse approach》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Prediction of lattice thermal conductivity of half-Heusler compounds by machine learning and transfer-function calibration
core_items.title_zh: 通过机器学习和传递函数校准预测半赫斯勒化合物的晶格热导率
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.26788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput searches for half-Heusler thermoelectrics increasingly rely on lattice thermal conductivity (κ_L) from first-principles calculations, or from machine-learning models trained on them. These calculations describe an ideal single crystal, whereas measurements are made on polycrystalline samples, in which grain boundaries and defects scatter heat as well. The resulting gap between calculated and measured κ_L has been noted for individual compounds but not, to our knowledge, quantified across a materials class, so the values used for screening carry an unknown, systematic bias. Here we quantify and correct this bias for cubic half-Heusler compounds with 18 valence electrons. Using a curated literature corpus that keeps calculated and measured values apart, we show that calculations overestimate measured κ_L in most bonding families, and that the excess shrinks with temperature. Scattering by defects, added to the intrinsic scattering between lattice vibrations, would give such a trend, but the data do not single out one cause. A simple transfer function with this temperature dependence removes the median offset, and refitting its magnitude within a bonding family lowers the median error further, though not consistently compound by compound. Combined with a machine-learning model that predicts the calculated value from crystal structure, and tested on chemistries withheld from all fitting, the method predicts measured κ_L in this class about as closely as independent laboratories agree with one another, and provides testable predictions for compounds not yet measured.
core_items.abstract_zh: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。使用将计算值和测量值分开的精选文献语料库，我们表明计算高估了大多数键合族中的测量 κ_L，并且超出部分随着温度而缩小。缺陷的散射加上晶格振动之间的固有散射，会给出这样的趋势，但数据并没有指出一个原因。具有这种温度依赖性的简单传递函数消除了中值偏移，并且在键合族中重新拟合其大小进一步降低了中值误差，尽管化合物之间的复合并不一致。该方法与根据晶体结构预测计算值的机器学习模型相结合，并对所有拟合中保留的化学物质进行测试，预测此类中测量的 κ_L 与独立实验室之间的一致程度接近，并为尚未测量的化合物提供可测试的预测。

core_items.title_en: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
core_items.title_zh: 用于碱活化渣性能预测和设计空间探索的反应性机器学习
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2606.06765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. The average metal oxide dissociation energy (AMODE), a physically interpretable representation of precursor reactivity, provides a compact alternative descriptor to explicit oxide compositions while enabling comparable predictive performance. Model interpretation revealed physically consistent trends from heterogeneous data, including non-monotonic effects of Na2O dosage and silicate modulus, reduced predicted strength at higher water content and larger specimen size, and coupled oxide-level effects more coherently represented by AMODE than by individual oxide contents. Statistically constrained design space exploration reveals reactivity-dependent trade-offs among strength, embodied CO2 emissions, and cost. The design maps identify high-strength regions with substantially lower CO2 emissions than OPC-based references at similar cost. Overall, this work demonstrates how reactivity-informed ML can extract physically meaningful trends from heterogeneous AAS data and guide source-dependent binder design. The curated dataset is publicly accessible to support advances in cement and concrete research.
core_items.abstract_zh: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。在逐渐丰富的特征场景中对多种机器学习 (ML) 算法进行了基准测试，证明整合 GGBS 成分、细度、固化条件和样本几何形状可以提高预测性能。平均金属氧化物解离能 (AMODE) 是前体反应性的物理可解释表示，为明确的氧化物成分提供了紧凑的替代描述符，同时实现了可比较的预测性能。模型解释揭示了异质数据的物理一致趋势，包括 Na2O 用量和硅酸盐模量的非单调效应、较高含水量和较大样本尺寸时预测强度的降低，以及 AMODE 比单个氧化物含量更连贯地表示耦合氧化物水平效应。统计约束的设计空间探索揭示了强度、二氧化碳排放量和成本之间依赖于反应性的权衡。设计图确定了高强度区域，其二氧化碳排放量比基于 OPC 的参考在相似成本下要低得多。总体而言，这项工作演示了基于反应性的 ML 如何从异构 AAS 数据中提取物理上有意义的趋势，并指导依赖于源的 Binder 设计。整理的数据集可公开访问，以支持水泥和混凝土研究的进步。
core_items.summary: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《用于碱活化渣性能预测和设计空间探索的反应性机器学习》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
